a: Ate leichallofe begitta. takkinu hachi: "beyom peloni meana pelonit bat peloni beanpana".

Tanu rabbanan: e zehu meun? amra: "i efshi bifloni bali", "i efshi bekiddushin shekkiddeshuni immi veachay". yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda: afillu yoshevet beappiryon veholechet mibbet aviha levet balah, veamra: "i efshi bifloni bali" — zehu meun.

Yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda: afillu hayu orchin mesubbin bevet balah vehi omedet umashka alehem, veamra lahem: "i efshi bifloni bali" — hare hu meun. yater al ken amar rabbi yose bar yehuda: afillu shiggerah balah etzel chenvani lehavi lo chefetz mishshello, veamra: "i efshi bifloni bali" — en lecha meun gadol mizze.

Rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: kol tinoket vechulei. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi chanina ben antignos. tana: ketanna shello meana, veamda venisset, mishshum rabbi yehuda ben betira amru: nissueha hen hen meuneha.
Ibbaya lehu: nitkaddesha, mahu? ta shema: ketanna shello meana veamda venitkaddesha — mishshum rabbi yehuda ben betira amru: kiddusheha hen hen meuneha.

Ibbaya lehu: peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi yehuda ben betira o la? im timtze lomar peligi: bekiddushin, o afillu benissuin? veim timtze lomar peligi afillu benissuin: halacha kemoto o en halacha kemoto? veim timtze lomar halacha kemoto: benissuin o afillu bekiddushin?
Ta shema, amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betira. halacha — mikkelal difligi.

Veakkatti tibbee lach: dahava nesiva meikkara, o dilma mikkaddesha? ta shema: dechallateh deabbadan, immerud, shaddar rabbi zuge derabbanan lemivdekinhu. amri lehu neshe: chazu gavrayychu dekaatu. amri lehu: nihvo gavrayychu didchu.
Amar rabbi: en lecha meun gadol mizze. may lav, dahava nesiva? la, dahava mikkaddesha kiddushe. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda ben betira, vaafillu benissuin dekamma.

Rabbi elazar omer vechulei. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: chozrani al kol tzidde chachamim velo matzati adam shehishva middotav biktanna kerabbi elazar. sheasaah rabbi elazar kimtayyelet immo bechatzer, veomedet mecheko vetovelet veochelet bitruma laerev.

Tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: en maase ketanna kelum, veen balah zakkay lo bimtziatah, velo bemaase yadeha, velo bahafarat nedareha, veeno yorshah, veen mittamme lah. kelalo shel davar: enah keishto lechol davar, ella shetztzericha meun.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: balah zakkay bimtziatah, uvemaase yadeha, uvahafarat nedareha, veyorshah, umittamme lah. kelalo shel davar: hare hi keishto lechol davar, ella sheyyotza bemeun.
Amar rabbi: nirin divre rabbi eliezer middivre rabbi yehoshua. sherabbi eliezer hishva middotav biktanna, verabbi yehoshua chalak. may chalak? i ishto hi — tive get.
Lerabbi eliezer name: i lav ishto hi — meun name la tive! ella bichdi tippok?!

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer vechulei. hechi dame akkava shehi min haish veakkava sheenah min haish? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: tevauha linnase, veamra: "mechamat peloni bali" — zo hi akkava shehi min haish. "mechamat bene adam sheenam mehugganin li" — zo hi akkava sheenah min haish.

Abbaye bar avin verav chanina bar avin deamri tarvayyhu: natan lah get — zo hi akkava shehi min haish, vehu asur bikrovoteha, vehi asura bikrovav, ufesalah min hakkehunna. meana bo — zo hi akkava sheenah min haish, vehu muttar bikrovoteha, vehi mutteret bikrovav, velo pesalah min hakkehunna.

Ha katane lekamman: hamemaenet baish — hu muttar bikrovoteha, vehi mutteret bikrovav, velo pesalah min hakkehunna. natan lah get — hu asur bikrovoteha, vehi asura bikrovav, ufesalah min hakkehunna! paroshe kamfaresh.
Mishna hamemaenet baish — hu muttar bikrovoteha, vehi mutteret bikrovav, velo pesalah min hakkehunna. natan lah get — hu asur bikrovoteha, vehi asura bikrovav, ufesalah min hakkehunna.
Natan lah get vehechzirah, meana bo venisset leacher, venitarmela o nitgarsha — mutteret lachzor lo. meana bo vehechzirah, natan lah get venisset leacher, venitarmela o nitgarsha — asura lachzor lo.
b: Ze hakkelal: get achar meun — asura lachzor lo, meun achar get — mutteret lachzor lo.
Hamemaenet baish venisset leacher vegershah, leacher umeana bo, leacher vegershah, ze hakkelal: kol sheyyotza hemennu beget — asura lachzor lo, bemeun — mutteret lachzor lo.
Gemara alma ate meun umevattel get.

Ureminhi: hamemaenet baish venisset leacher vegershah, leacher umeana bo, leacher vegershah, ze hakkelal: kol sheyyatzta hemennu beget — asura lachzor lo, bemeun — mutteret lachzor lo. alma la ate meun dechavreh u[m]vattel gitta dideh.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: tavra, mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo.

Amar rava: umay kusheya? vedilma: meun dideh mevattel get dideh, meun dechavreh la mevattel gitta dideh. umay shena meun dechavreh dela mevattel gitta dideh — ayyeyde demakkeret birmizotav ukeritzotav azel meshabbesh umayyte la, meun dideh name la livattel gitta dideh — deayyeyde demakkeret birmizotav ukeritzotav azel meshabbesh umayyte la!
Ha kevar shabbesha vela ishtabbasha.

Ella i kashya, dechavreh addechavreh kashya: meana bo vehechzirah, natan lah get venisset leacher, venitarmela o nitgarsha — asura lachzor lo. tama denitarmela o nitgarsha. ha meana — mutteret lachzor lo, alma ate meun dechavreh umevattel gitta dideh.

Ureminhi: hamemaenet baish venisset leacher vegershah, leacher umeana bo, ze hakkelal: kol sheyyatzta mimmennu beget — asura lachzor lo, bemeun — mutteret lachzor lo. alma la ate meun dechavreh umevattel gitta dideh!
Amar rabbi elazar: tivra, mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo. ulla amar: kegon sheshshillesha begittin, demichazzeya kigdola.

Man tanna? amar rav yehuda amar rav, may dichtiv: "memenu bechesef shatinu etzenu bimchir yavou"? bishat hassakkana nitbakkesha halacha zo: hare sheyyatza merishon beget umishsheni bemeun, mahu shettachazor larishon?
Sachru adam echad bearba meot zuz, veshaalu et rabbi akiva bevet haasurin, veasar. et rabbi yehuda ben betira bintzivin, veasar.
Amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: lezo lo hutzerachnu. leissur karet hittarta, leissur lav — lo kol shekken.

Beram kach shaalu: hare hayta eshet achi immo, shehi sheniyyay lo, unesaah achiv meaviv umet, mahu shettemaen hasheta vetikerinhu lenissuin kammae, vetityaybem (tzarata). yesh meun leachar mita bimkom mitzva, o la?
Sachru shene bene adam bearba meot zuz, uvau veshaalu et rabbi akiva bevet haasurin, veasar. et rabbi yehuda ben betira bintzivin, veasar.
Amar rav yitzchak bar ashyan: umode rav, shemmutteret leachiv shel ze shenneesra alav.
Peshita, hu nihu demakkeret birmizotav ukeritzotav, aval achiv la! mahu detema: ligzar hay attu hay, ka mashma lan.
Veikka deamri, amar rav yitzchak bar ashyan: keshem sheasura lo, kach asura laachin. veha enah makkeret bikritzotehem uremizotehem? gezera achiv attu hu.
Mishna hamegaresh et haishsha vehechzirah — mutteret layyavam.

a: Verabbi elazar oser. vechen hamegaresh et hayyetoma vehechzirah — mutteret layyavam. verabbi elazar oser. ketanna shehissiah aviha, venitgarsha — kitoma bechayye haav. vehechzirah — divre hakkol asura layyavam.
Gemara amar efa: may tama derabbi elazar — hoil veamda alav shaa achat beissura. amaru leh rabbanan leefa: i hachi, chalitza name la tive!
Vechi tema: hachi name, vehatanya, mishshum rabbi elazar amru: choletzet! ella amar efa: rabbi elazar la yadana may tama.

Amar abbaye, hayeynu tama derabbi elazar: mesappeka leh i mita mappelet, i nissuin harishonim mappilim. i mita mappelet — ha ramya kammeh leyibbum, i nissuin harishonim mappilim — ha amda alav shaa achat beissur.
Rava amar: leolam peshita lerabbi elazar demita mappelet, umihu hakkol bekiin begerushin, veen hakkol bekiin bachazara.
Adderabba: chazara, kevan deyatva tuteh, it leh kala! mi la askinan deahdera beureta ushechev betzafra.

Rav ashe amar: hayeynu tama derabbi elazar, degazar hane mishshum yetoma bechayye haav vehechzirah. hachi name mistabbera, middekatane sefa: ketanna shehissiah aviha venitgarsha, kitoma bechayye haav. vehechzirah — divre hakkol sheasura layyavam.
Hay may lememra? peshita! ella lav ha ka mashma lan, tama derabbi elazar degazar hanach mishshum hay. shema minna.

Tanya kevoteh derav ashe: modim chachamim lerabbi elazar biktanna shehissiah aviha venitgarsha — hare hi kitoma bechayye haav, vehechzirah — sheasura layyavam, mippene sheggerusheha gerushin gemurin, veen chazaratah chazara gemura.

Bamme devarim amurim — sheggershah keshehi ketanna vehechzirah keshehi ketanna. aval gershah keshehi ketanna vehechzirah keshehi gedola, i name hechzirah keshehi ketanna vegadla etzlo vamet — o choletzet o mityaybemet. mishshum rabbi elazar amru: choletzet velo mityaybemet.
Bea minneh rava merav nachman: tzaratah, mahu? amar leh: hi gufa gezera, vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera?

Veha tanya, mishshum rabbi elazar amru: hi vetzaratah choletzet. hi vetzaratah salka datach?! ella lav: o hi o tzaratah choletzet? lav tarotze kamtartzat, taretz hachi: hi — choletzet, tzaratah — o choletzet o mityaybemet.

Mishna shene achin nesuin lishte achayot ketannot, umet balah shel achat mehen — hallezu tetze mishshum achot ishsha. vechen shete chershot. gedola uketanna, met balah shel ketanna — tetze hakketanna mishshum achot ishsha.
Met balah shel gedola, rabbi eliezer omer: melammedin et hakketanna shettemaen bo.
Rabban gamliel omer: im meana — meana, veim lav — tamtin ad shettagdil, vetetze hallezu mishshum achot ishsha.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: i lo al ishto, i lo al eshet achiv. motzi et ishto beget — veeshet achiv bachalitza.

Gemara umi shere? vehatane bar kappara: leolam yidbak adam bishlosha devarim, veyitrachek mishshelosha devarim. yidbak bishlosha devarim: bachalitza, uvahavaat shalom, uvahafarat nedarim. veyitrachek mishshelosha devarim: min hammeun, umin happikdonot, umin haervonot! meun demitzva shane.

Gufa. tane bar kappara: leolam yidbak adam bishlosha devarim: bachalitza — keabba shaul, detanya, abba shaul omer: hakkones et yevimto leshem noy, leshem ishut, leshem davar acher — keillu pogea beerva, vekarov beenay lihyot havvalad mamzer.
Bahavaat shalom, dichtiv: "bakkesh shalom verodfehu",
b: Veamar rabbi avahu: atya "redifa" "redifa". ketiv hacha: "bakkesh shalom verodfehu", uchetiv hatam: "rodef tzedaka vachased yimtza chayyim tzedaka vechavod". bahafarat nedarim, kerabbi natan. detanya, rabbi natan omer: hannoder — keillu bana bama. vehamekayyeymo — keillu hikriv aleha korban.
Veyitrachek mishshelosha devarim: min hammeunin — dilma gadla umicharta bah. min happikdonot — bevar mata, devayyteh ki vayyteh dame. min haeravon — baarave shaltziyyon.

Deamar rabbi yitzchak: may dichtiv: "ra yeroa ki arav zar" — raa achar raa tavo limkabbele gerim, velaarave shaltziyyon, uletokea atzmo lidvar halacha. mekabbele gerim — kerabbi chelbo. deamar rabbi chelbo: kashim gerim leyisrael kesappachat baor.
Arave shaltziyyon — deavdi shelof dotz. tokea atzmo lidvar halacha — detanya, rabbi yose omer: kol haomer en lo tora — en lo tora. peshita! ella: kol haomer en lo ella tora — en lo ella tora.
Ha name peshita! ella daafillu tora en lo. may tama? amar rav pappa, amar kera: "velimmadtem vaasitem" — kol sheyyeshno baasiyya yeshno bilmida, kol sheeno baasiyya eno bilmida.
Veibbaet ema, leolam kidamritu meikkara: kol haomer en lo ella tora — en lo ella tora, la tzericha deka magmar leacharine veazli veavdi. mahu detema: it leh agra ledideh, ka mashma lan.
Veibbaet ema, tokea atzmo lidvar halacha: bedayyayna deate dina lekammeh, vegamar halacha umedamme milleta lemilleta, veit leh rabba vela azel meshael.

Deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: leolam yire dayyayn atzmo keillu cherev munnachat lo ben yerechotav, vegehinnam petucha lo mittachtav, shenneemar: "hinne mittato shellishlomo shishshim gibborim saviv lah miggibbore yisrael vegomer mippachad ballelot", mippachad shel gehinnam sheddome lelayla.
Rabban gamliel omer: im meana vechulei. bea minneh rabbi elazar merav: may tama derabban gamliel — mishshum dekasavar kiddushe ketanna mitla telu, vechi gadla gadli bahada, af al gav dela beal,
O dilma mishshum dekasavar: hamekaddesh achot yevama — niftera yevama vehalcha lah, i beal — in, i la beal — la?
Amar leh: hayeynu tama derabban gamliel, mishshum dekasavar: hamekaddesh achot yevama — niftera yevama vehalcha lah, i beal — in, i la beal — la.
Amar rav sheshet: amena, ki nayem veshachev rav, amar leha shemata. detanya: hamekaddesh et hakketanna — kiddusheha teluyin. may "teluyin"? lav ki gadla gadli bahada, veaf al gav dela baal?
Amar leh ravin bereh derav nachman: ha milleta diktanna, mitla talya vekayyma, i beal — in, i la beal — la. deamra: hu adif minnay, vaana adifna minneh.
Vesavar rav: i beal — in, i la beal — la? veha ittemar: ketanna shello meana, vehigdila, veamda venisset, rav amar: enah tzericha get mishsheni, ushemuel amar: tzericha get mishsheni.

a: May lav, dela beal? la, dival. i dival, may tama dishmuel? kasavar: kol habboel — al daat kiddushin harishonim hu boel.
Veha peligi ba chada zimna, deittemar: kiddeshah al tenay, uchenasah setam — rav amar: tzericha hemennu get, ushemuel amar: enah tzericha hemennu get.
Rav amar tzericha hemennu get — kevan denasva achole achaleh litnaeh. ushemuel amar: enah tzericha hemennu get, kol habboel, al daat kiddushin harishonim hu boel!

Tzericha, dei ittemar hahi, behahi kaamar rav, mishshum deikka tenaa, vechevan dival, achaleh litnaeh. aval beha, ema mode leh, lishmuel. vei ittemar beha: behach kaamar shemuel, aval behach, ema mode leh lerav, tzericha.

Umi amar rav ki beal — in, i la beal — la? ha hahi ovada dahava benaresh, veikkaddisha keshehi ketanna, vegadla, veotvay abbe churesyay, vaata acharina vechatfa minneh. verav berona verav chananel talmide derav havo hatam, vela atzreychuha gitta mibbatra!
Amar rav pappa: benaresh minsav nasyvi, vahadar motvi abbe churesyay. rav ashe amar: hu asa shello kahogen, lefichach asu bo shello kahogen, veafkeinhu rabbanan lekiddushe minneh.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: tinach dekaddesh bechaspa, kaddesh bevia may? shavveyuha rabbanan livilato beilat zenut. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi eliezer. vechen amar rabbi elazar: halacha kerabbi eliezer.
Mishna mi shehaya nasuy lishte yetomot ketannot, umet — biatah o chalitzatah shel achat mehem poteret tzaratah. vechen shete chershot. ketanna vechereshet — en biat achat mehen poteret tzaratah.

Pikkachat vechereshet — biat happikkachat poteret hachereshet, veen biat hachereshet poteret et happikkachat. gedola uketanna — biat haggedola poteret hakketanna, veen biat hakketanna poteret haggedola.
Gemara vechereshet bat chalitza hi? vehatnan: cheresh shennechlatz, vechereshet shechaltza, vecholetzet min hakkatan — chalitzatah pesula!
Amar rav giddel amar rav: abbia. rava amar: afillu tema achalitza — kan bechereshet meikkara, kan befikkachat veachar kach nitcharsha.
Chereshet meikkara, ki hechi deal — hachi nafek, pikkachat veachar kach nitcharsha — la, dimakkeva ba keriyyay.

Etiveh abbaye: vechereshet meikkara bat chalitza hi? vehatnan: shene achin, echad pikkeach veechad cheresh, nesuin lishte nochriyyot, achat pikkachat veachat chereshet, met cheresh baal chereshet, ma yaase pikkeach baal pikkachat? kones. veim ratza lehotzi — yotzi.
Met pikkeach baal pikkachat, ma yaase cheresh baal chereshet? kones, veeno motzi leolam. may lav, bechereshet meikkara, vekatane: kones in,
b: Choletz la! la, befikkachat veachar kach nitcharsha.

Ta shema: shene achin pikchin nesuin shete nochriyyot, achat pikkachat veachat chereshet, met pikkeach baal hachereshet, ma yaase pikkeach baal pikkachat? kones, veim rotze lehotzi yotzi. met pikkeach baal pikkachat, ma yaase pikkeach baal chereshet? o choletz o meyaybem.
May lav: middehu pikkeach meikkara, hi name chereshet meikkara, vekatane: kones in, choletz la! midde irya? ha kidita veha kidita.

Etiveh: shene achin, echad pikkeach veechad cheresh, nesuin shete achayot, achat pikkachat veachat chereshet. met cheresh baal chereshet, ma yaase pikkeach baal pikkachat? tetze mishshum achot ishsha.
Met pikkeach baal pikkachat, ma yaase cheresh baal chereshet? motzi et ishto beget, veeshet achiv asura leolam.
Vechi tema hacha name befikkeach veachar kach nitcharesh — mi matze mappek? vehatnan: nitcharsha — yotzi, nishtattet — lo yotzi. nitcharesh hu o nishtatta — lo yotzi olamit.

Ella lav, becheresh meikkara, umiddehu cheresh meikkara — hi name chereshet meikkara. umiddaachayot chershot meikkara — nochriyyot name chershot meikkara, utenan gabbe nochriyyot: kones in, choletz la! ishtik.
Ki ata lekammeh derav yosef, amar leh: may tama totveh meha, deyachevl leshannoye lach: achayot — chershot meikkara, nochriyyot — pikkechot veachar kach nitcharshu.

Ella ibbei lach leotoveh meha: shene achin chershin nesuin shete achayot pikkechot, o shete achayot chershot, o shete achayot achat pikkachat veachat chereshet. vechen shete achayot chershot nesuot lishne achin pikchin, o lishne achin chershin, o lishne achin echad pikkeach veechad cheresh — hare ellu peturot min hachalitza umin hayyibbum. veim hayu nochriyyot — yichnosu, veim ratzu lehotzi — yotziu.
Hechi dame? illema befikchim ulevassof nitcharshu, mi matze mappeki? vehatnan: nishtattet — lo yotzi, nitcharesh hu o nishtatta — lo yotzi olamit!
Ella lav achershin meikkara, umiddehen chershin meikkara — inhu name chershot meikkara, vekatane: im hayu nochriyyot — yichnosu. yichnosu — in, yachlotzu — la! teyuveta derabba teyuveta.

Ketanna vechereshet vechulei. amar rav nachman: ashkachteh lerav adda bar ahava ulerav chana chatneh, deyatvi vekamakvu akvota beshuka defumebdita veamri, ha ditnan: ketanna vechereshet, en biat achat mehen poteret tzaratah, hane mille dinfala leh meachiv pikkeach, dela yadinan i biktanna nicha leh i bechereshet nicha leh
I biktanna nicha leh — deatya lichlal dea, i bechereshet nicha — digdola hi, uvat bia hi. aval nafla meachiv cheresh — vadday bechereshet nicha leh, devat bia hi uvat minneh hi.
Veamena lehu ana: afillu nefala leh meachiv cheresh name mesappeka leh.
Ketzad takkanatan? amar rav chisda amar rav: kones hachereshet umotziah beget, uketanna tamtin ad shettagdil, vetachlotz.

Amar rav chisda: shema minna, kasavar rav: chereshet kenuya umeshuyyeret, ketanna kenuya veenah kenuya. dei salka datach chereshet kenuya veenah kenuya, ketanna kenuya umeshuyyeret, chereshet ammay kones umotziah beget?

a: Tittev gabbeh mimma nafshach: i kenuya hi — ha kenuya hi, vei lav kenuya hi — ha nochrit bealma hi.
Vechi tema, ketanna ammay tamtin ad shettagdil vetachlotz? tittev gabbeh, i kenuya hi — ha kenuya hi, i lav kenuya hi — nucherita bealma hi! im ken, chereshet bema tippok.
Amar rav sheshet: hachi name mistabbera, kidka metaretz rav chisda allibba derav,
Detanya: shene achin nesuin shete achayot yetomot, ketanna vechereshet, met balah shel ketanna — chereshet yotza beget, uketanna tamtin ad shettagdil, vetachlotz.
Met balah shel chereshet — ketanna yotza beget, vechereshet asura leolam. veim ba al hachereshet — noten lah get, vehuttera.

I amrat bishlama chereshet kenuya umeshuyyeret, ketanna kenuya veenah kenuya — mishshum hachi dechi ba al hachereshet noten lah get vehuttera, deamrat mimma nafshach: i ketanna kenuya hi — ha nafka mishshum achot ishsha, i lav kenuya — shappir meyabbem.
Ella i amrat chereshet kenuya veenah kenuya, ketanna kenuya umeshuyyeret, ki va al chereshet ammay noten get vehuttera? havya leh bia pesula — uvia pesula la patra.
Ha manni — rabbi nechemya hi, deamar: bia pesula, poteret mechalitza.

I rabbi nechemya, ema sefa: mi shehaya nasuy shete yetomot, ketanna vechereshet, umet. ba yavam al hakketanna, vechazar uva al hachereshet, o shebba achiv al hachereshet — neesru shetehen alav. ketzad takkanatan? chereshet yotzet beget, uketanna tamtin ad shettagdil, vetachlotz.

I amrat bishlama chereshet kenuya umeshuyyeret, ketanna kenuya veenah kenuya, verabbanan hi — mishshum hachi tamtin ad shettagdil, vetachlotz — dedilma kadem uvael chereshet beresha, vehavya leh bia diktanna bia pesula.
Ella i amrat rabbi nechemya, ha amar bia pesula patra!
Ella shema minna rabbanan hi. shema minna.
Amar rav ashe: meresha name shema minna derabbanan hi, dekatane: im ba al hachereshet — noten lah get, vehuttera, vela katane: im ba al hakketanna — noten lah get vehuttera.
I mishshum ha la irya: chereshet, delet la takkanta dehettera — katane takkanta deissura. ketanna, deit la takkanta dehettera — la tane takkanta deissura.
Mishna mi shehaya nasuy lishte yetomot ketannot, umet, uva yavam al harishona, vechazar uva al hashsheniyya, o shebba achiv al hashsheniyya —
b: Lo pasal et harishona, vechen shete chershot.
Ketanna vechereshet. ba yavam al hakketanna, vechazar uva al hachereshet, o shebba achiv al hachereshet — pasal et hakketanna.
Ba yavam al hachereshet, vechazar uva al hakketanna, o shebba achiv al hakketanna — pasal et hachereshet.
Pikkachat vechereshet. ba yavam al happikkachat, vechazar uva al hachereshet, o shebba achiv al hachereshet — lo pasal et happikkachat.
Ba yavam al hachereshet vechazar uva al happikkachat, o shebba achiv al happikkachat — pasal et hachereshet.

Gedola uketanna. ba yavam al haggedola, vechazar uva al hakketanna, o shebba achiv al hakketanna — lo pasal et haggedola. ba yavam al hakketanna, vechazar uva al haggedola, o shebba achiv al haggedola — pasal et hakketanna. rabbi elazar omer: melammedin hakketanna shettemaen bo.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi elazar. vechen amar rabbi elazar: halacha kerabbi elazar.
Utzericha, dei ittemar beha kammayyta, behach kaamar shemuel halacha kerabbi eliezer — mishshum dela kayyem mitzvat yibbum, aval beha, deikkayyaym mitzvat yibbum — ema tarvayyhu lippeku beget,
Vei ashmeinan beha, mishshum digdola ramya kammeh. aval iddach — la. tzericha.
Mishna yavam katan, shebba al yevama ketanna — yigdelu ze im ze. ba al yevama gedola — tegaddelennu.

Hayyevama sheamra betoch sheloshim yom "lo nivalti" — kofin oto sheyyachlotz lah. leachar sheloshim yom — mevakkeshin hemennu sheyyachlotz lah. uvizman shehu mode — afillu leachar shenem asar chodesh kofin oto sheyyachlotz lah.

Hannoderet hanaa miyyevamah, bechayye balah — kofin oto sheyyachlotz lah. leachar mitat balah — mevakkeshin hemennu sheyyachlotz lah. veim nitkavvevna lechach — afillu bechayye valah mevakkeshin hemennu sheyyachlotz lah.
Gemara lema matnitin dela kerabbi meir. detanya: katan uketanna lo choltzin velo mityaybmin, divre rabbi meir.
Afillu tema rabbi meir, ki amar rabbi meir, gedola lekatan uketanna legadol, dechad minnayyhu bia deissura hu. aval katan habba al hakketanna, detarvayyhu ki hadade ninhu, la amar.
Veha katane: ba al yevama gedola — tegaddelennu! amar rabbi chanina chozaa: ba shane. veha tegaddelennu kaamar, dechol bia uvia deissura hu! ella mechavvavrta matnitin dela kerabbi meir.
Keri kan "lehakim leachiv shem", vehay lav bar hachi hu! amar abbaye, amar kera: "yevamah yavo aleha" — kol dehu.

Rava amar: belav hachi name la matzet amrat, mi ikka midde dehashta asira leh ulevatar shata sharya? veha amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol yevama sheen ani kore bishat nefila "yevamah yavo aleha" — hare hi keeshet ach sheyyesh lo banim, vaasura.
Veema hachi name! amar kera: "ki yeshvu achim yachdav", afillu ben yom echad.
Yevama sheamra betoch sheloshim yom vechulei. man tanna dead telatin yomin mokem inish annafsheh?
Amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi meir hi. detanya: taanat betulim — kol sheloshim yom, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yose omer: nistera — lealtar, lo nistera — af leachar kamma shanim.
Rabba amar: afillu tema rabbi yose. ad kan la kaamar rabbi yose hatam ella baarusato degis ba. aval eshet achiv —

a: Mivzaz beziz minna.
Ad shekkofin oto lachlotz — nichpennu leyaybem! amar rav: besheggittah yotze mittachat yadah.

Metivi: yevama sheamra betoch sheloshim yom "lo nivalti" — ben shehu omer "baalti", ben shehu omer "lo baalti", kofin oto sheyyachlotz lah. leachar sheloshim yom — mevakkeshin hemennu sheyyachlotz lah.
Hi omeret "nivalti", vehu omer "lo baalti" — hare ze yotzi beget. hu omer "baalti", vehi omeret "lo nivalti" — af al pi shechazar veamar "lo baalti", tzarich get vachalitza.
Amar rabbi amme: tzericha chalitza im gittah. rav ashe amar: hatam — get lezikkato, hacha — get leviato.
Hanhu shenehem modim daato lekammeh derava, amar lehu rava: chalutzu la, ushero la tigra. amar leh rav sherevya lerava: vehatanya tzericha get vachalitza! amar leh: i tanya — tanya.
Bea minneh hun bereh derav nachman midderav nachman: tzaratah mahu?
Amar leh: vechi mippene sheanu kofin umevakkeshin, teaser tzara?
Hannoderet hanaa vechulei. tenan hatam, barishona hayu omrim: shalosh nashim yotzot venotlot ketubba.
Haomeret "temea ani lecha", "hashshamayim beni levenach", "netula ani min hayyehudim".
Chazru lomar, shello tehe ishsha notenet eneha beacher umekalkelet al balah. ella: "haomeret temea ani lecha" — tavi reaya lidvareha. "hashshamayim beni levenach" — yaasu derech bakkasha.
"Netula ani min hayyehudim" — yafer chelko, umeshammashto, utehe netula min hayyehudim.
Ibbaya lehu: "netula ani min hayyehudim" layyavam mahu? mi masseka addata demayet baalah venafla kamme yavam, o la.

Rav amar: yavam eno kevaal, ushemuel amar: yavam hare hu kevaal. amar abbaye: kevoteh derav mistabbera, ditnan: hannoderet hanaa miyyevamah bechayye valah, kofin oto sheyyachlotz. veim ita demasseka addata —
b: "Mevakkeshin" mibbee leh. hacha bemay askinan, beishsha sheyyesh lah banim, dechulle hay la masseka addata.

Aval en lah banim, may — mevakkeshin? addetane "im nitkavvevna lechach, afillu bechayye valah mevakkeshin mimmennu sheyyachlotz lah", liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim — besheyyesh lah banim, aval en lah banim — mevakkeshin!
Ella shema minna: la shena yesh lah banim, vela shena en lah banim — kofin oto kerav, shema minna.
Hadaran alach bet shammay
Cheresh shennasa pikkachat ufikkeach shennasa chereshet, im ratza lehotzi — yotzi, veim ratza lekayyem — yekayyem. keshem shehu kones birmiza — kach hu motzi birmiza.
Pikkeach shennasa pikkachat venitcharsha, im ratza — yotzi, veim ratza — yekayyem. nishtattet — lo yotzi. nitcharesh hu o nishtatta — eno motziah olamit.

Amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri: mippene ma haishsha shennitcharsha yotza, vehaish shennitcharesh eno motzi? amru lo: eno dome haish hamegaresh laishsha hammitgareshet, shehaishsha yotza lirtzonah veshello lirtzonah, vehaish eno motzi ella lirtzono.
Heid rabbi yochanan ben gudegda al hachereshet shehissiah aviha shehi yotza beget. amru lo: af zo kayyotze bah.

Shene achin chershin nesuin lishte achayot chershot, o lishte achayot pikkechot, o lishte achayot achat chereshet veachat pikkachat. o shete achayot chershot (nesuin) [nesuot] lishne achin pikchin, o lishne achin chershin, o lishne achin echad cheresh veechad pikkeach — hare ellu peturin min hachalitza umin hayyibbum. veim hayu nochriyyot — yichnosu, veim ratzu lehotzi — yotziu.
Shene achin, echad cheresh veechad pikkeach, nesuin lishte achayot pikkechot. met cheresh baal happikkachat, ma yaase pikkeach baal happikkachat — tetze mishshum achot ishsha.
Met pikkeach baal happikkachat, ma yaase cheresh baal pikkachat — motzi ishto beget, veeshet achiv asura leolam.

Shene achin pikchin nesuin lishte achayot, achat chereshet veachat pikkachat. met pikkeach baal chereshet, ma yaase pikkeach baal pikkachat — tetze mishshum achot ishsha. met pikkeach baal pikkachat, ma yaase pikkeach baal hachereshet — motzi et ishto beget, veet eshet achiv bachalitza.
Shene achin, echad cheresh veechad pikkeach, nesuin lishte achayot, achat chereshet veachat pikkachat. met cheresh baal chereshet, ma yaase pikkeach baal pikkachat — tetze mishshum achot ishsha.
Met pikkeach baal pikkachat, ma yaase cheresh baal chereshet — motzi et ishto beget, veeshet achiv asura leolam.

Shene achin, echad cheresh veechad pikkeach, nesuin lishte nochriyyot pikkechot. met cheresh baal pikkachat, ma yaase pikkeach baal pikkachat — o choletz o meyaybem. met pikkeach baal pikkachat, ma yaase cheresh baal pikkachat — kones veeno motzi leolam.

Shene achin pikchin nesuin lishte nochriyyot, achat pikkachat veachat chereshet. met pikkeach baal chereshet, ma yaase pikkeach baal pikkachat — kones, veim ratza lehotzi — yotzi. met pikkeach baal pikkachat, ma yaase pikkeach baal chereshet — o choletz o meyaybem.

Shene achin, echad cheresh veechad pikkeach, nesuim lishte nochriyyot, achat chereshet veachat pikkachat. met cheresh baal chereshet, ma yaase pikkeach baal pikkachat — kones, veim ratza lehotzi — yotzi. met pikkeach baal pikkachat, ma yaase cheresh baal chereshet — kones veeno motzi leolam.

Gemara amar rame bar chama: may shena cheresh vechereshet detakkinu lehu rabbanan nissuin, umay shena deshote veshota dela takkinu lehu rabbanan nissuin? detanya: shote vekatan shennasu nashim umetu — neshotehen peturot min hachalitza umin hayyibbum!

Cheresh vechereshet, dekayyma takkanta derabbanan — takkinu lehu rabbanan nissuin. shote veshota, dela kayyma takkanta derabbanan, deen adam dar im nachash bichfifa achat — la takkinu rabbanan nissuin.

Umay shena katan dela takkinu rabbanan nissuin, vecheresh takkinu le rabbanan nissuin? cheresh, dela ate lichlal nissuin — takkinu rabbanan nissuin, katan, deate lichlal nissuin — la takkinu rabbanan nissuin.
Vahare ketanna, deatya lichlal nissuin, vetakkinu rabbanan nissuin! hatam — shello yinhagu [bah] minhag hefker.
Umay shena ketanna dimmaana, umay shena chereshet dela memaana? deim ken,

a: Mimmani vela nasvi la.

Umay shena ketanna deachla bitruma, umay shena chereshet dela achla bitruma? ditnan: heid rabbi yochanan ben gudegda al hachereshet shehissiah aviha sheyyotza beget, veal ketanna bat yisrael shennisset lechohen sheochelet bitruma, veillu chereshet la achla!
Gezera shemma yaachil cheresh bechereshet. velechol, katan ochel nevelot hu!
Gezera shemma yaachil cheresh befikkachat. vecheresh befikkachat name lechol bitruma derabbanan! gezera dilma ate leochola bitruma deorayyta.
Umay shena ketanna deit la ketubba, umay shena chereshet delet la ketubba? deim ken — mimmani vela nasvi la.
Uketanna menalan deit la ketubba? ditnan: hamemaenet, vehashsheniyyay, veayylonit — en lahen ketubba. aval yotza beget uketanna — yesh lah ketubba.

Vechereshet menalan delet la ketubba? detanya: cheresh veshote shennasu pikkechot, af al pi shennitpakkeach hacheresh, venishtappa hashshote — en lahem alehem kelum. ratzu lekayyeyman — yesh lahem ketubba.
Ufikkeach shennasa chereshet o shota, afillu katav lah mea mane — ketubbatah kayyemet, mippene sheratza lizzok binchasav. tama deratza, ha lo ratza — en lah, deim ken mimmani vela nasvi la.
I hachi, pikkachat lecheresh litakken la ketubba, deim ken mimmani vela minnasvi! yoter mishshehaish rotze lissa, ishsha rotza lehinnase.

Hahu cheresh dahava beshivavuteh derav malkiyyo, anseveh itteta uchetav la arba mea zuze minnichseh. amar rava: man chakkim kerav malkiyyo, degavra rabba hu. kasavar: illu ratza shifcha leshammesho mi la zavninan leh? kol shekken hacha, deikka tarte.
Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar shemuel: eshet cheresh — en chayyayvin aleha asham taluy.

Lema mesayyay leh: chamishsha lo yitromu, veim tarmu — en terumatan teruma. veellu hen: cheresh, shote, vekatan, vehattorem et sheeno shello, vegoy shettaram shel yisrael afillu birshut yisrael — en terumato teruma.
Hu deamar kerabbi elazar. detanya: rabbi yitzchak omer mishshum rabbi elazar: terumat cheresh lo tetze lechullin, mippene shehu safek. i sevira kerabbi elazar, asham taluy name lichayyayv!
Baenan chaticha mishte chatichot.
Umi bae rabbi elazar chaticha mishte chatichot? vehatanya, rabbi elazar omer: koy — chayyayvin al chelbo asham taluy.
Shemuel savar kerabbi elazar bachada, ufelig aleh bachada.
Veikka deamri, amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar shemuel: eshet cheresh chayyayvin aleha asham taluy. metivi: chamishsha lo yitromu! savar la kerabbi elazar.
Bea rav ashe: may tama derabbi elazar? mifshat peshita leh decheresh data kelishta hu, umihu mesappeka leh i data tzilluta
b: I lav data tzilluta, uleolam chada data hu. o dilma peshita leh dedateh kelishta velav data tzilluta hu, vehacha hayeynu tama: kevan deittim chalim veittim shote.
Lemay nafka minna — lehotzi ishto beget. i amrat chada data hu — kekiddushin kach gerushin.
Vei amrat ittim chalim veittim shote — kaddoshe matze mekaddesh, garoshe la matze megaresh. may? teku.
Nishtattet vechulei. amar rabbi yitzchak: devar tora shota mitgareshet, midde dehave appikkachat beal korchah. uma taam amru enah megoreshet? shello yinhagu bah minhag hefker.
Hechi dame? illema deyodaat lishmor gittah veyodaat lishmor atzmah — mi nahagi bah minhag hefker? ella, deen yodaat lishmor lo gittah velo atzmah.
Devar tora shota mitgareshet? veha amar deve rabbi yannay: "venatan beyadah", mi sheyyesh lah yad legaresh atzmah, yatzta zo, sheen lah yad legaresh atzmah.
Vetana deve rabbi yishmael: "veshillechah mibbeto", mi shemmeshallechah veenah chozeret, yatzta zo, shemmeshallechah vechozeret.
La tzericha, deyodaat lishmor gittah veenah yodaat lishmor atzmah. devar tora shota mitgareshet, deha yodaat lishmor gittah. vaamur rabbanan la laypka, shello yinhagu bah minhag hefker.

Amar abbaye: dayka name, dekatane gabbe dida "nishtattet lo yotzi", vegabbe dideh "lo yotzi olamit". may shena hacha dekatane "olamit" umay shena hatam dela katane "olamit"? ella shema minna, ha — deorayyta, ha — derabbanan.
Amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri vechulei. ibbaya lehu? rabbi yochanan ben nuri, ish peshita leh, veishsha kamibbaya leh. o dilma: ishsha peshita leh, veish kamibbaya leh.

Ta shema, middekaamru leh: eno dome haish hamegaresh laishsha hammitgareshet, shehaishsha yotzet lirtzonah veshello lirtzonah, vehaish eno motzi ella lirtzono — shema minna ish kamibbaya leh. adderabba, middekaamru leh: af zo kayyotze bah — shema minna ishsha kamibbaya leh.

Ella, rabbi yochanan ben nuri ledivrehem kaamar lehu: ledidi, ki hechi deish la matze megaresh — ishsha name la miggarsha, ella ledidchu, may shena ishsha umay shena ish! amaru leh: eno dome haish hamegaresh laishsha hammitgareshet.
Heid rabbi yochanan vechulei. amar rava: meeduto shel rabbi yochanan ben gudegda, amar leedim: "reu get ze sheani noten", veamar lah: "kinsi shetar chov ze" — hare zo megoreshet.
Mi la amar rabbi yochanan ben gudegda la baenan data, hacha name la baenan data. peshita?

Mahu detema: middaamar la "kinsi shetar chov ze" — battole batteleh, ka mashma lan. i ita devatteleh — leedim hava kaamar lehu, umiddela amar leedim — la batteleh vela midde. vehay dekaamar hachi — mechamat kissufa hu dekaamar lehu.
Rav yitzchak bar bisna irchasu leh mafteche deve midresha birshut harabbim beshabbeta, ata lekammeh derabbi pedat. amar leh: zil

a: Devar tele vetalya velitayyeylu hatam, dei mashkechi lehu, mayyte lehu. alma kasavar: katan ochel nevelot — en bet din metzuvvivyn lehaferisho. lema mesayyay leh: lo yomar adam letinok "have li mafteach", "have li chotam", ella mannicho tolesh, mannicho zorek.
Amar abbaye: "tolesh" — beatzitz sheeno nakuv, "zorek" — becharmelit derabbanan.
Ta shema: goy shebba lechabbot — en omrim lo "kabbe" veal techabbe", mippene sheen shevitato alehem. katan habba lechabbot — omrim lo "al techabbe", sheshshevitato alehem.
Amar rabbi yochanan: beose al daat aviv, dichvoteh gabbe goy deose al daat yisrael, mi shere? goy addata denafsheh aved.
Ta shema: ben chaver sheragil lelech etzel avi immo am haaretz — en choshshin shemma yaachilennu devarim sheenam metukkanim. matza beyado perot — en zakuk lo! amar rabbi yochanan: bidmay hekellu.
Ella tama didmay, ha vadday bea leassore? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: beose al daat aviv! ella rabbi yochanan sappoke mesappeka leh, kae hacha medache, kae hacha medache.
Ta shema: ben chaver kohen sheragil lelech etzel avi immo kohen am haaretz — en choshshin shemma yaachilennu teruma temea, matza beyado perot — en zakuk lo! bitruma derabbanan.

Ta shema: yonek tinok veholech miggoya umibbehema temea, veen choshshin beyonek sheketz. velo yaachilennu nevelot uterefot shekatzim uremasim. umikkullan yonek mehem vaafillu bashshabbat. uvegadol asur. abba shaul omer: nohagin hayinu sheyyonkim mibbehema tehora beyom tov.
Katane miha en choshshin beyonek sheketz! hatam mishshum sakkana. i hachi — gadol name!
Gadol bae umedana. katan name live umedana! amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: setam tinok mesukkan etzel chalav.
Abba shaul omer: nohagin hayinu sheyyonkim mibbehema tehora beyom tov. hechi dame? i deikka sakkana — afillu beshabbat name, vei delekka sakkana — afillu beyom tov asur! la tzericha deikka tzaara.
Vekasavar mefarek kilachar yad hu. shabbat deissur sekila — gezaru rabbanan, yom tov deissur lav — la gezaru beh rabbanan.
Ta shema: "lo tochlum ki sheketz hem", lo taachilum — lehazehir haggedolim al hakketannim. may lav, deamar lehu lo techlu! la, dela lispo leh beyadayim.
Ta shema: "kol nefesh mikkem lo tochal dam", lehazehir haggedolim al hakketannim. may lav, deamri lehu lo techlu! la, dela lispo lehu beyadayim.
Ta shema: "emor ... veamarta", lehazehir gedolim al hakketannim. may lav, deamar lehu la tittammo! la, dela litammo lehu beyadayim.
Utzerichi: dei ashmeinan shekatzim —
b: Mishshum deissuran bemashshehu, aval dam — dead deikka reviit, ema la. vei ashmeinan dam — mishshum deikka karet, aval sheratzim, ema la.
Vei ashmeinan hane tarte — mishshum deissuran shave bakkol, aval tumea, ema la. vei ashmeinan tumea — kohanim shane, mishshum deribba bahen mitzvot yeterot, aval hane, ema la, tzericha.
Ta shema: shene achin, echad pikkeach veechad cheresh, nesuin shete achayot pikkechot. met cheresh baal pikkachat, ma yaase pikkeach baal pikkachat? tetze mishshum achot ishsha.
Met pikkeach baal pikkachat, ma yaase cheresh baal pikkachat? motzi et ishto beget, veeshet achiv asura leolam.
Ammay motzi et ishto beget? tittiv gabbeh, katan ochel nevelot hu! mishshum issura dida.

Ta shema: shene achin pikchin nesuin shete achayot, achat pikkachat veachat chereshet. met pikkeach baal chereshet, ma yaase pikkeach baal pikkachat? tetze mishshum achot ishsha. met pikkeach baal pikkachat, ma yaase pikkeach baal chereshet? motzi et ishto bagget, veeshet achiv bachalitza.
Veammay motzi et ishto beget? tittev gabbeh, katan ochel nevelot hu! mishshum issura dideh.

Amar rava, ta shema: shene achin, echad cheresh veechad pikkeach nesuin lishte achayot, achat pikkachat veachat chereshet. met cheresh baal chereshet, ma yaase pikkeach baal pikkachat? tetze mishshum achot ishto. met pikkeach baal pikkachat, ma yaase cheresh baal chereshet? motzi et ishto beget, veeshet achiv asura leolam.
Veha hacha delav issura dida ikka, velav issura dideh ikka, vekatane: motzi et ishto beget! amar rav shemaya: gezera mishshum hattarat yevama lashshuk.
Hadaran alach cheresh
Haishsha shehalcha hi uvalah limdinat hayyam. shalom beno levenah, veshalom baolam. uvaa veamra: "met bali" — tinnase. "met bali" — tityaybem.

Shalom beno levenah, umilchama baolam. ketata beno levenah, veshalom baolam. uvata veamra: "met bali" — enah neemenet. rabbi yehuda omer: leolam enah neemenet, ella im ken bata bocha, uvegadeha keruin. amru lo: achat zo veachat zo tinnase.
Gemara tena "shalom beno levenah", mishshum dekavae lemitne "ketata beno levenah". tena "shalom baolam", mishshum dekavae lemitne "milchama beolam".

Amar rava: may tama demilchama — mishshum deamra biddame: salka data bechol hane deikketul, hu palet? im timtza lomar, kevan deshalom beno levenah natra ad dechazya, zimnin demachu leh begira o berumecha vesavra vadday met, veikka deaved samtari vechaye.

Savar rava lememar reavon eno kemilchama, dela amra biddame. hadar amar rava: reavon hare hu kemilchama. dehahi daatat lekammeh derava, amara leh: "bali met baraav". amar la: shappir avadt deshezivt nafshich? salka datach divhahu pureta dinfafita dishvakt leh hava chaye? amara leh: mar name yada dechi hay gavvna la chaye.
Hadar amar rava: reavon geria mimmilchama. deillu milchama, ki amra: "met bali bammilchama" hu dela mehemna, ha "met al mittato" — mehemna. veillu gabbe reavon, ad deamra: "met ukevartiv".
Mappolet — hare hu kemilchama, deamra biddame. shilluach nechashim veakrabbim — hare hen kemilchama, deamra biddame.

Dever — amri la hare hu kemilchama, veamri la eno kemilchama. amri la hare hu kemilchama, deamri biddame. veamri la eno kemilchama, desamchi addeamri inashe: shav shenin have motana, veinash bela shene la azel.
Ibbaya lehu: hechzika hi milchama baolam, mahu? mi amrinan ma lah leshakker,

a: Dei baaya amra: "shalom baolam". o dilma: kevan deichazka — amra biddame, vela ate "ma li leshakker" umara chezkateh.
Ta shema: "ishsheynu alenu bayit", "ishsheynu alenu meara", "hu met, vaani nitztzalti" — enah neemenet. shane hatam, deamar lah: ki hechi dildidach itrechish nissa, ledideh name itrechish nissa.
Ta shema: "naflu alenu goyim", "naflu alenu listim", "hu met, venitztzalti" — neemenet. hatam, kidrav idi. deamar rav idi: ishsha kele zayynah aleha.
Hahu gavra divshilhe hilluleh ittelay nura be (ganenay) [genaneh]. amara lehu devethu: "chazo gavray! chazo gavray!" ato, chazo gavra charocha dishde, ufisseta dida deshadya.

Savar rav chiyyay bar avin lememar: hayeynu "ishsheynu alenu bayit, ishsheynu alenu meara". amar rava: mi dame? hatam la kaamra "chazo gavray, chazo gavray". veod, gavra charocha dishde, ufisseta dida deshadya.
Verav chiyyay bar avin — gavra charocha dishde, ema inish acharina ata leatztzole, vaachaylteh nura. ufisseta dida deshadya — nura ittelay veityelid beh muma, umechamat kissufa azal vaarak lealma.

Ibbaya lehu: ed echad bammilchama mahu? tama deed echad meheman — mishshum demilleta daavida leiggalloye hu la meshakkar, hacha name la meshakkar. o dilma: tama deed echad mishshum dehi gufa dayyka uminnasva, vehacha [kevan dezimnin desanya leh], la dayyka uminnasva.

Amar rame bar chama: ta shema, amar rabbi akiva: kesheyyaradti linhardea leabber hashshana, metzaani nechemya ish bet deli, veamar li: shamati sheen massiin et haishsha beeretz yisrael al pi ed echad, ella rabbi yehuda ben bava. venamti lo: ken haddevarim. amar li, emor lahem mishshemi: attem yodim hammedina hazzo meshubbeshet bigyaysot? kach mekubbelani merabban gamliel hazzaken, shemmassiin haishsha al pi ed echad.
May medina meshubbeshet bigyaysot? lav, af al gav dimdina zo meshubbeshet, kach mekubbelani shemmassiin al pi ed echad. alma ed echad meheman.

Amar rava: i hachi, may shena "medina zo"? "kol makom sheyyesh geyaysot" mibbee leh! ella amar rava, hachi kaamar: attem yodim shemmedina zo meshubbeshet bigyaysot, vela efshar li lemishbak inashe veti umeyte kamme rabbanan. kach mekubbelani merabban gamliel shemmassiin haishsha al pi ed echad.

Ta shema: maase bishne talmide chachamim shehayu bain im abba yose ben simay bisfina, vetava, vehissi rabbi neshotehen al pi nashim. veha mayim kemilchama damu. venashim, afillu mea — keed echad damu, vekatane: hissi!
Vetisbera? mayim sheen lahem sof ninhu, umayim sheen lahem sof — ishto asura. ella hechi dame, deamri: assekinhu kamman
b: Vachazenhu lealtar, vekaamri simanin. delav alayyhu samchinan, ella assimanim.
Hahu gavra deafked shumeshme gabbe chavreh, amar leh: hav li shumeshmay. amar leh: shekayltinhu: veha ken vechen havayin, uvechavita ramyin. amar leh: didach shekaltinhu, vehane — acharine ninhu.
Sevar rav chisda lememar: hayeynu shene talmide chachamim, vela amrinan: hanach azalu lealma, vehane acharine ninhu.
Amar leh rava: mi dame? hatam, kaamri simanim. hacha, shumeshme may simana it lehu? udekaamar "ken vechen havayin" — emar chushebana itremi.

Amar leh mar kashshisha bar rav chisda lerav ashe: umi chayyshinan shemma pinnan? vehatnan: matza cheli vechatuv alav kof — korban, mem — maaser, dalet — dimmua, tet — tevel, tav — teruma. shebbishat hassakkana hayu kotvin tav tachat teruma!
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: vela chayyshinan shemma pinnan? ema sefa, rabbi yose omer: afillu matza chavit vechatuv aleha teruma — hare ellu chullin, sheani omer: eshtakad hava male teruma, ufinnah!
Ella: dechulle alma chayyshinan shemma pinnan, vehacha beha kamippalgi. mar savar: im ita definnahu — michpar hava kafar. veiddach: emar ishteloye ishteli. i name, lefanchayya shavkeh.

Yitzchak resh galuta, bar achateh derav bivi, hava kaazel mikkuretava leaspamya, ushechev. shelachu mehatam: yitzchak resh galuta, bar achateh derav bivi, hava kaazel mikkuretava leaspamya, ushechev. mi chayyshinan litre yitzchak, o la? abbaye amar: chayyshinan. rava amar: la chayyshinan.

Amar abbaye: mena amena la, dehahu gitta deishtechach binhardea uchetiv: betzad kelonya mata ana anderolinay nehardaa petarit vetarechit yat pelonit inteti. veshalcha avu dishmuel lekammeh derabbi yehuda nesia. ushelach leh: tibbadek nehardea kullah.
Verava amar: im ita — "yibbadek kol haolam" mibbee leh?! ella mishshum kevodo daavu dishmuel hu dishlach hachi.

Amar rava: mena amena la — dehanhu tere shetare denafki bemachoza uchetiv behu: chave bar nannay venannay bar chave, veagbi behu rava bar avu zuze. veha chave bar nannay venannay bar chave bemachoza shechichi tuva. veabbaye?

a: Lemay nechush la? i linfila — mizhar zehir beh. i lefikkadon — kevan dishmeh kishmeh la mafked gabbeh.
May amrat, dilma mesar leh? otiyyot niknot bimsira.

Hahu gitta deishtechach besura uchetiv beh hachi: besura mata ana anan bar chiyyay nehardaa petarit vetarechit pelonit inteti. uvedaku rabbanan missura vead nehardea, vela hava anan bar chiyyay acharina levar meanan bar chiyyay mechaggera dahava binhardea. vaato sahadi veemor dehahu yoma ki ikketav hahu gitta, anan bar chiyyay mechaggera gabban hava.
Amar abbaye: af ledidi deamena chayyshinan — hacha la chayyshinan, deha kaamri sahadi devinhardea hava, may bea besura.
Amar rava: af ledidi dela chayyshinan — hacha chayyshinan, dilma begamla parcha azal. i name bikfitza. i name mille mesar.

Kedaamar lehu rav lesafre, vechen amar lehu rav huna lesafre: ki itanchu beshile ketuvu beshile, af al gav demimmasran mille behine. vechi itanchu behine ketuvu behine, af al gav demimmasran mille beshile.
May hava alayyhu deshumeshme? rav yemar amar: la chayyshinan. ravina amar: chayyshinan. vehilcheta: chayyshinan.
Ketata beno levenah vechulei. hechi dame ketata beno levenah, amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: beomeret levalah "garsheni". kullehu name amru hachi! ella beomeret levalah "gerashtani".
Velihemna midderav hamenuna. deamar rav hamenuna: ishsha sheamra levalah "gerashtani" — neemenet. chazaka en ishsha meizza paneha bifne balah!
Beomeret "gerashtani bifne peloni ufeloni", veshaelna veamru: "lo hayu devarim meolam".
May tama diktata? rav chanina amar: mishshum dimshakkera. rav shimi bar ashe amar: mishshum deamra biddame. may benayyhu?
b: Ikka benayyhu deargel hu ketata.

Ibbaya lehu: ed echad biktata, mahu? may tama deed echad meheman: mishshum demilleta daavida leiggalloye la meshakkar — hacha name la meshakkar, o dilma: tama deed echad meheman mishshum dehi dayyka uminnasva, vehacha, kevan deit leh ketata, la dayyka uminnasva? teku.
Rabbi yehuda omer leolam enah vechulei. tanya, amru lo lerabbi yehuda: lidvarecha, pikkachat — tinnase, shota — lo tinnase?! ella, achat zo veachat zo tinnase.
Hahi daatay leve dina derabbi yehuda, amri la: sifdi balich, kerai manich, sitri mazyich. allefuha shikra? inhu kerabbanan sevira lehu, amri: taaved hachi ki hechi delishreyuha.
Mishna bet hillel omrim: lo shamanu ella bevaa min hakkatzir, uveotah medina, uchemaase shehaya.

Amru lahem bet shammay: achat habbaa min hakkatzir, veachat habbaa min hazzetim, veachat habbaa min habbatzir, veachat habbaa mimmedina limdina. lo dibberu chachamim bakkatzir ella bahove. chazru bet hillel lehorot kevet shammay.
Gemara tanya, amru lahem bet shammay levet hillel: ledivrechem, en li ella ketzir chittim — ketzir seorim, minnayin? veen li ella kotzer — botzer, mosek, goder, oder, minnayin?
Ella maase shehaya bakkatzir, vehu haddin lechullehu. hacha name: maase shehaya beotah medina, vehu haddin lechullehu.
Uvet hillel: beotah medina dishchichi inashe — mirtat, mimmedina limdina acheret, dela shechichi inashe — la mirtat. uvet shammay: hacha name shechichi shayyayrata.

May maase shehaya? deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shilfe katzir chittin hayu, vehalchu asara bene adam liktzor chittin, neshacho nachash leechad mehen umet, uvat ishto vehodia levet din. veshalchu umatzu kidvareha. beotah shaa amru: haishsha sheamra "met bali" — tinnase, "met bali" — tityaybem.
Nema rabbi chananya ben akiva verabbanan biflugeta devet shammay uvet hillel kamippalgi? detanya: lo yissa adam me chattat veefer chattat veyaavirem bayyarden uvisfina,

Velo yaamod betzad ze veyizrok letzad acher, velo yeshitem al pene hammayim, velo yarkivem lo al gabbe behema velo al gabbe chavero, ella im ken hayu raglav nogot bakkarka. aval maaviram al haggesher, echad yarden veechad shear neharot. rabbi chananya ben akiva omer: lo amru ella yarden, uvisfina, uchemaase shehaya.
Lema rabbanan deamri kevet shammay. verabbi chananya ben akiva deamar kevet hillel.

Amri lach rabbanan: anan deamrinan af kevet hillel, ad kan la kaamar bet hillel hatam, ella mishshum demiratta[1]; bemakom karov — miratta[1], bemakom rachok — la miratta[1]. hacha, ma li yarden ma li shear neharot.

Rabbi chananya ben akiva amar lach: ana daamari af levet shammay. ad kan la kaamri bet shammay hatam, ella mishshum deihi dayyka uminnasva, ma li makom karov ma li makom rachok. hacha, mishshum maase shehaya. bayyarden uvisfina dahava maase — gezur rabbanan, bishar neharot dela hava maase — la gezur rabbanan.

May maase shehaya? deamar rav yehuda amar rav: maase beadam shehaya maavir me chattat veefer chattat bayyarden uvisfina, venimtza kezayit min hammet tachuv bekarkait shel sefina. beotah shaa amru: lo yissa adam me chattat veefer chattat veyaavirem bayyarden uvisfina.

Mishna bet shammay omrim: tinnase, vetittol ketubbatah. bet hillel omrim: tinnase, velo tittol ketubbatah. amru lahem bet shammay: hittartem erva chamura, velo nattir mamon hakkal?! amru lahem bet hillel: matzinu

a: Sheen haachin nichnasin lannachala al piha!
Amru lahem bet shammay: vahalo missefer ketubba nilmod, shehu kotev lah: sheim tinnasi leacher titteli ma shekkatuv lichi. vechazru bet hillel lehorot kedivre bet shammay.
Gemara amar rav chisda: nityaybma — yevamah nichnas lannachala al piha. hem darshu midrash ketubba — anu lo nidrosh midrash tora?!
"Yakum al shem achiv" amar rachamana, vahare kam.

Amar rav nachman: bat levet din veamra "met bali, hattiruni lehinnase" — mattirin otah lehinnase venotnin lah ketubbatah. "tenu li ketubbati" — af lehinnase en mattirin otah. may tama — addata dichtubba atay.

Ibbaya lehu: "hattiruni lehinnase utenu li ketubbati", mahu? kevan deamra ketubbeta — addata dichtubba atay, o dilma: kol mille deit leh leinish amar lehu leve dina. [veim timtze lomar kol mille deit leh leinish, amar lehu leve dina] "tenu li ketubbati vehattiruni lehinnase", mahu?
Hacha vadday addata dichtubba atay, o dilma: hoil dela yada bemay mishtarya?! teku.
Mishna hakkol neemanin lehaidah, chutz mechamotah, uvat chamotah, vetzaratah, vivimtah, uvat baalah.
Ma ben get lemita — shehakketav mochiach.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: bat chamiha mahu? tama devat chamotah — mishshum deikka imma desanya la, hi name sanya la, vehacha lekka imma desanya la.
O dilma tama devat chamotah, deamra: "kaachla legirsana deimma", hacha name kaamra: "achla legirsana deve nashay".
Ta shema: hakkol neemanin lehaidah chutz mechamesh nashim. veim ita, shet havyayn! dilma tama devat chamotah, deamra: "kaachla legirsana deve nashay", la shena bat chamotah vela shena bat chamiha.
Vehaanan tenan: chutz mishsheva nashim! hahi, rabbi yehuda hi. ditnan: rabbi yehuda mosif af eshet av vehakkalla.
Amru lo: eshet av hare hi bichlal bat habbaal, kalla hare bichlal chamotah.

Verabbi yehuda, bishlama chamotah sanya la lechalla, deamra: kaachla legirsanay. ella kalla may tama sanya lachamotah? bishlama bat habbaal desanya leeshet haav, deamra: kaachla legirsane deem. ella eshet haav, may tama sanya levat habbaal?
Ella may mosif tarte? ella: kalla may tama sanya lachamotah — dimgalla livnah kol deavda, eshet av name sanya levat habbaal — dimgalla leaviha kol deavda.
Verabbanan: "kammayim happanim lappanim ken lev haadam laadam". verabbi yehuda: hahi bedivre tora ketiv.
Amar rav acha bar avya, bau bemareva: chamotah habbaa leachar mikken mahu? mi masseka addata demayet baal venafla kamme yavam vesanya la, o la?
b: Ta shema, amra: "met bali veachar kach met chami" — tinnase vetittol ketubba, vachamotah asura. may tama chamotah asura? lav mishshum deamrinan la bala miyt vela chamuha miyt, veha dekaamra hachi — lekalkola lachamotah hu dekamikkavvevna,
Savra: levatar shata la tete (titztaaran).
Dilma shane hatam, dirgish la tzaara.

Mishna ed omer "met", venisset, uva echad veamar "lo met" — hare zo lo tetze. ed omer "met", ushenayim omrim "lo met" — af al pi shennisset, tetze. shenayim omrim "met", veed omer "lo met" — af al pi shello nisset, tinnase.
Gemara tama denisset, ha lo nisset — lo tinnase. vehaamar ulla: kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad — hare kan shenayim, veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim.
Hachi kaamar: ed echad omer "met", vehittiruha lehinnase, uva echad veamar "lo met" — lo tetze mehetterah harishon.
Ed omer "met" — peshita, deen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim! la tzericha, bifsule edut, vechidrabbi nechemya.
Detanya, rabbi nechemya omer: kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad — hallech achar rov deot, veasu shete nashim beish echad kishne anashim beish echad.
Veibbaet ema: kol hecha daata ed echad kasher meikkara — afillu mea nashim keed echad damyayn. ella kegon daatay ishsha meikkara.

Vetartza lidrabbi nechemya hachi, rabbi nechemya omer: kol makom sheheemina tora ed echad — hallech achar rov deot, veasu shete nashim beishsha achat kishne anashim beish echad. aval shete nashim beish echad — kefalga ufalga dame.
Shenayim omrim "met" vechulei. may kamashma lan? bifsule edut, vechidrabbi nechemya, deazel batar rov deot? hayeynu hach!
Mahu detema: ki azlinan batar rov deot — lechumera, aval lekulla — la, ka mashma lan.
Mishna achat omeret "met" veachat omeret "lo met". zo sheomeret "met" — tinnase vetittol ketubbatah, vezo sheomeret "lo met" — lo tinnase velo tittol ketubbatah.

Achat omeret "met" veachat omeret "neherag", rabbi meir omer: hoil umachchishot zo et zo — hare ellu lo yinnasu. rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon omrim: hoil vezo vazo modot sheen kayyaym — yinnasu. ed omer "met" veed omer "lo met",

a: Ishsha omeret: "met", veishsha omeret: "lo met" — hare zo lo tinnase.
Gemara tama deamra "lo met", ha ishtika — tinnase? ha en tzara meida lachavertah!
"Lo met" itztericha leh, salka datach amena: ha mayet, veha dekaamra "lo met" — lekalkola letzara hi dekamikkavvevna, vetamot nafshah im pelishtim" kaamra, kamashma lan.

Achat omeret met kulei. veliflog rabbi meir beresha! amar rabbi elazar: bemachloket shenuya, verabbi yehuda verabbi shimon hi. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema rabbi meir, beha afillu rabbi meir mode dechol "lo met" beedut ishsha lav hachechasha hi.
Tenan: ed omer "met", veed omer "lo met", ishsha omeret "met" veishsha omeret "lo met" — hare zo lo tinnase. bishlama lerabbi elazar — setama kerabbi meir, ella lerabbi yochanan kashya! kashya.
Mishna haishsha shehalcha hi uvalah limdinat hayyam, uvaa veamra "met bali" — tinnase vetittol ketubbatah, vetzaratah asura. hayta bat yisrael lechohen — tochal bitruma, divre rabbi tarfon.
Rabbi akiva omer: en zo derech motziato mide avera, ad shettehe asura linnase, vaasura milleechol bitruma.

Amra: "met (li) bali, veachar kach met chami" — tinnase vetittol ketubbatah, vachamotah asura. hayta bat yisrael lechohen — tochal bitruma, divre rabbi tarfon. rabbi akiva omer: en zo derech motzia[ta] mide avera, ad shettehe asura linnase vaasura milleechol bitruma.
Gemara utzericha, dei ittemar hach kammayyta — beha kaamar rabbi tarfon, mishshum detzara degufa. aval chamot, detzara mille dealma — ema mode leh lerabbi akiva.
Vei ittemar beha — beha kaamar rabbi akiva, aval behach — ema mode leh lerabbi tarfon, tzericha.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi tarfon. amar abbaye, af anan name tenena: "nittan li ben bimdinat hayyam. met beni, veachar kach bali" — neemenet. "bali, veachar kach beni" — enah neemenet.
Vechoshshin lidvareha, vecholetzet velo mityaybemet. lidvareha hu dechoshshin, ha ledivre tzara — en choshshin. shema minna.
b: Mishna kiddesh achat mechamesh nashim, veen yodea e zo kiddesh, kol achat omeret: "oti kiddesh" — noten get lechol achat veachat, umanniach ketubba benehen, umistallek, divre rabbi tarfon.

Rabbi akiva omer: en zo derech motzi mide avera, ad sheyyitten get uchetubba lechol achat veachat. gazal echad mechamishsha veen yodea meeze gazal, kol echad omer "oti gazal" — manniach gezela benehen umistallek, divre rabbi tarfon. rabbi akiva omer: en zo derech motzi mide avera, ad sheyyeshallem lechol echad veechad.
Gemara "kiddesh" — katane, "baal" — la katane. "gazal" — katane, "lakach" — la katane. manni matnitin? la tanna kamma vela rabbi shimon ben elazar!

Detanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: lo nechleku rabbi tarfon verabbi akiva al shekkiddesh achat mechamesh nashim veeno yodea ezo kiddesh, shemmanniach ketubba benehen umistallek. al ma nechleku — al shebbaal. rabbi tarfon omer: manniach ketubba benehen umistallek, rabbi akiva omer: ad sheyyeshallem lechol achat veachat.

Lo nechleku rabbi tarfon verabbi akiva al shellakach mikkach mechamishsha bene adam veen yodea meeze mehen lakach — shemmanniach deme mikkach benehen umistallek. lo nechleku ella sheggazal mechamishsha, sheamar rabbi tarfon: manniach gezela benehem umistallek, verabbi akiva omer: ad sheyyeshallem gezela lechol echad veechad.
Middekaamar rabbi shimon ben elazar bekiddesh" velakach" la peligi, mikkelal detanna kamma savar peligi. manni?
I tanna kamma — litne "kiddesh" velakach". i rabbi shimon ben elazar — litne "baal" vegazal".
Leolam rabbi shimon ben elazar, umay "kiddesh" — kiddesh bevia. tena "kiddesh", lehodiacha kocho derabbi akiva,
Deaf al gav deissura derabbanan avad, kanes! tena "gazal", lehodiacha kocho derabbi tarfon, deaf al gav deissura deorayyta avad, la kanes.

Mishna haishsha shehalcha hi uvalah limdinat hayyam uvenah immahem, uvat veamra: "met bali veachar kach met beni" — neemenet. met beni veachar kach met bali" — enah neemenet. vechoshshin lidvareha, vecholetzet velo mityaybemet.
"Nittan li ben bimdinat hayyam", veamra: "met beni, veachar kach met bali" — neemenet. "met bali, veachar kach met beni" — enah neemenet. vechoshshin lidvareha, vecholetzet velo mityaybemet.
"Nittan li yavam bimdinat hayyam", amra: "met bali veachar kach met yevami", "yevami veachar kach bali" — neemenet.

Halcha hi uvalah vivamah limdinat hayyam, amra: "met bali, veachar kach yevami", "yevami, veachar kach bali" — enah neemenet, sheen haishsha neemenet lomar "met yevami" shettinnase, velo "meta achotah" shettikkanes leveto, veen haish neeman lomar "met achi" sheyyeyabbem ishto, velo "meta ishto", sheyyissa achotah.

Gemara bea minneh rava merav nachman: hamezakke get leishto bimkom yavam, mahu? kevan desanya leh — zechut hu lah, vezachin leadam shello befanav. o dilma: kevan dezimnin derachama leh, chov hu lah, veen chavin laadam shello befanav.
Amar leh, tenena: vechoshshin lidvareha, vecholetzet velo mityaybemet.

Amar leh ravina lerava: hamezakke get leishto bimkom ketata, mahu? kevan deit la ketata bahadeh — zechut hu lah. o dilma, neyacha degufa adif la? ta shema, deamar resh lakish: tav lemetav tan du millemetav armelu.
Abbaye amar: deshumeshmana gavra, kuresya be charata ramu la. rav pappa amar: denappatza gavra, tikre besippe vava vetittiv.
Rav ashe omer: dekolsa gavra, la baaya telafche lekidra. tana: vechullan mezannot vetolot bevalehen.
Hadaran alach haishsha shalom

a: Haishsha shehalach balah vetzaratah limdinat hayyam, uvau veamru lah: "met balich" — lo tinnase, velo tityaybem ad shetteda shemma meubberet hi tzaratah.
Hayta lah chamot — enah chosheshet. yatzta melea — chosheshet. rabbi yehoshua omer: enah chosheshet.
Gemara may "hi tzaratah"? ha ka mashma lan: leha tzara hu dechayyshinan, aval letzara achariti la chayyshinan.
Lo tinnase velo tityaybem vechulei. bishlama yabbome la, dedilma miabbera, vekafaga beeshet ach deorayyta. ella lo tinnase, ammay? hallech achar rov nashim, verov nashim mitabberot veyoldot!
Lema rabbi meir hi dechayesh lemiuta?
Afillu tema rabbanan, ki azli rabbanan batar rubba — rubba deiteh kamman, kegon tesha chanuyot vesanhedri. aval rubba deleteh kamman — la azli rabbanan batar rubba.

Vahare katan uketanna, derubba deleta kamman hi, veazli rabbanan batar rubba! detanya: katan uketanna lo choltzin velo meyaybmin, divre rabbi meir. amru lo lerabbi meir: yafe amarta sheen choltzin. "ish" ketiv bapparasha, umakkeshinan ishsha leish. ella ma taam en meyaybmin!

Amar lahem: katan shemma yimmatze saris, ketanna shemma timmatze aylonit, venimtzeu pogim beerva. verabbanan savri: zil batar rubba diktannim, verov ketannim lav sarise ninhu. zil batar rov ketannot, verov ketannot lav aylonit ninhu. ella, mechavvavrta matnitin rabbi meir hi.

Bemay okemta kerabbi meir, ema sefa: hayta lah chamot — enah chosheshet. ammay? hallech achar rov nashim, verov nashim mitabberot veyoldot, miut mappilot, vechol hayyoldot — mechetza zecharim umechetza nekevot. semoch miuta demappilot lemechetza nekevot, vehavu leh zecharim miuta — velechush!
Dilma kevan deichzeka lashshuk, la chayesh. resha deichzak leyibbum — tiyyaybam!
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: resha deissur karet — chashshu, sefa deissur lav — lo chashshu.
Amar rava: mikkede, ha deorayyta veha deorayyta — ma li issur karet ma li issur lav?! ella amar rava:
b: Resha, chazaka leyibbum, verubba lashshuk. vachazaka la adif ki rubba. veayyti miuta demappilot semoch lachazaka, vehave leh palga ufalga — lo tinnase velo tityaybem.
Sefa, chazaka lashshuk, verubba lashshuk. vehave leh zecharim miuta demiuta, umiuta demiuta — la chayesh rabbi meir.
Lo tinnase velo tityaybem vechulei. uleolam!
Amar zeeri: leatzmah — shelosha chodashim, lachavertah — tisha, vecholetzet mimma nafshach.
Rabbi chanina amar: leatzmah — shelosha, lachavertah — leolam. vetachlotz mimma nafshach!
Abbaye bar avin verabbi chanina bar avin amri tarvayyhu: gezera shemma yehe valad ben kayyayma, venimtza atta matzrichah karoz lakkehunna.
Velaytzrecha? dilma ikka dehave bachalitza vela have behacheraza, veamri: kasharu chalutza lechohen.
Tenan: "nittan li ben bimdinat hayyam", veamra: "met beni veachar kach bali" — neemenet. "met bali veachar kach beni" — enah neemenet, vechoshshin lidvareha, vecholetzet velo mityaybemet.
Velechush dilma atu edim veamri kidkaamra, venimtza atta matzrichah karoz lakkehunna! amar rav pappa: bigrusha. rav chiyyay bereh derav huna amar, beamra: "ani vahu nechbenu bimara".
Mishna shete yevamot, zo omeret: "met bali", vezo omeret: "met bali". zo asura mippene balah shel zo, vezo asura mippene balah shel zo.
Lazo edim, velazo en edim. et sheyyesh lah edim — asura, veet sheen lah edim — mutteret. lazo banim, velazo en banim. et sheyyesh lah banim — mutteret, veet sheen lah banim — asura.
Nityaybmu, umetu hayyevamin — asurot lehinnase. rabbi elazar omer: hoil vehutteru layyevamin — hutteru lechol adam.
Gemara tana: lazo edim uvanim, velazo lo edim velo banim — shetehen muttarot.
Nityaybmu umetu hayyevamin — asurin lehinnase. rabbi elazar omer: hoil vehutteru layyevamin — hutteru lechol adam.
Bae rava: may tama derabbi elazar? mishshum dekasavar tzara meida lachavertah, o dilma mishshum dehi la mekalkela nafsha.
Lemay nafka minna?

a: Leansove letzara mikkamme dida: i amrat tzara meida lachavertah, af al gav dela innesiv — mansevinan la letzara. i amrat mishshum dehi la mekalkela nafsha, innesiv — mansevinan la letzara, i la innesiv — la mansevinan la.
May? ta shema, rabbi elazar omer: hoil vehutteru layyevamin — hutteru lechol adam. i amrat bishlama dehi la mekalkela nafsha — hayeynu dechi innesiv, mansevinan la,
Ella i amrat mishshum detzara meida lachavertah — af al gav dela innesiv name! ella shema minna tama derabbi elazar mishshum deinnesiv hu, vela mekalkela nafsha.

Rabbi elazar ledivrehem kaamar lehu: ledidi, tzara meida lachavertah, veaf al gav dela innesiv — mansevinan la. ella ledidchu, odo li mihat dehecha deinnesiv — mansevinan la, mishshum dehi la mekalkela nafsha. verabbanan, "tamot nafshi im pelishtim" hu dekaavda.

Ta shema: haishsha shehalcha hi uvalah limdinat hayyam, uvaa veamra: "met bali" — tinnase vetittol ketubbatah, vetzaratah asura. rabbi elazar omer: hoil vehuttera hi — huttera name tzaratah. ema: hoil vehuttera venisset.
Velechush dilma begitta atay, vehay dekaamra hachi — lekalkola letzara hi mikkavvevna!
I deinnesiv leyisrael — hachi name. hacha bemay askinan, deinnesiv lechohen.

Mishna en meidin ella al partzuf panim im hachotem. af al pi sheyyesh simanin begufo uvechelav — en meidin ella ad shettetze nafsho. vaafillu rauhu meguyyayd vetzaluv vehachayya ochelet bo — en meidin ella ad shelosha yamim.
Rabbi yehuda ben bava omer: lo kol haadam velo kol hammakom velo kol hashshaot shavin.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: paddachat velo partzuf panim, partzuf panim velo paddachat — en meidin, ad sheyyehu shenehem im hachotem. amar abbaye, veittema rav kahana: may kera — "hakkarat penehem anta bam".
Abba bar marta dehu abba bar minyome hava masseki beh deve resha galuta zuze. ayyti kira, dabbek bivliyta, dabbek beapputeh. chalaf kammayyhu vela bashkeru.
Af al pi sheyyesh simanin vechulei. lememra desimanin lav deorayyta.
Ureminhi: metzao kashur bechis uvearnaki uvetabbaat, o shennimtza ben kelav, afillu lizman merubbe — kasher.

Amar abbaye, la kashya: ha rabbi eliezer ben mahavay, ha rabbanan. detanya: en meidin al hashshuma. rabbi eliezer ben mahavay omer: meidin. may lav beha kamippalgi, demar savar simanin deorayyta, umar savar simanin derabbanan?
Amar rava: dechulle alma simanin deorayyta. hacha, beshuma metzuya beven gilo kamippalgi. mar savar: shuma metzuya beven gilo, umar savar: enah metzuya beven gilo.
Veikka deamri: hacha beshuma haasuya lehishtannot leachar mita kamippalgi. mar savar: asuya lehishtannot leachar mita. umar savar: enah asuya lehishtannot leachar mita.
Veikka deamri, amar rava: dechulle alma simanin derabbanan. vehacha, beshuma
b: Siman muvehak ka mippalgi. mar savar siman muvehak, umar savar lav siman muvehak.
Ulehach lishshana deamar rava simanin deorayyta, ha katane: af al pi sheyyesh simanin begufo uvechelav!
Gufo — dearoch vegutz. kelav — dechayyshinan lishela. vei chayyshinan lishela, chamor besimane ukkaf hechi mahderinan?
La shayyli inashe ukkafa, dimsakkev leh lachamara. metzao kashur bechis uvearnaki uvetabbaat, hechi mahderinan?
Tabbaat — chayyshi lezayyofe. kis vearnaki — menachashi inashe vela moshli. veibbaet ema: kelav, bechivvare vesummake.
Vaafillu rauhu meguyyayd vechulei. lememra dimguyyayd chaye? ureminhi: adam eno metamme ad shettetze nafsho, afillu meguyyayd, vaafillu goses. tammoye la metamme, ha michyay — la chaye!

Amar abbaye, la kashya: ha rabbi shimon ben elazar, ha rabbanan, detanya: meidin al hameguyyayd, veen meidin al hatztzaluv. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: af al hameguyyayd en meidin, mippene sheyyachol likkavot velichyot.

Umi matzet leokome kerabbi shimon ben elazar? veha katane sefa: maase beasya beechad sheshshilsheluhu layyam, velo alta beyadam ella raglo, veamru chachamim: min haarkubba ulemala — tinnase, min haarkubba ulematta — lo tinnase.
Shane mayya demarzu makka.
Vehaamar rabba bar bar chana: ledidi chaze li hahu tayyaya deshakel safsira vegayyeydeh legamleh, vela afsektay lenaaruteh! amar abbaye: hahi kechisha haveya.
Rava amar: besakkin melubbenet, vedivre hakkol.
Vehachayya ochelet vechulei. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo shanu ella mimmakom sheen nafsho yotza, aval mimmakom shennafsho yotza — meidin.
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shachat bo shenayim, o rov shenayim, uvarach — meidin.
Ini? vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shachat bo shenayim o rov shenayim, veramaz veamar: "kitvu get leishti" — hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. chay hu, vesofo lamut.
Ella meatta, yehe gole al yado. allema tanya: shachat shenayim o rov shenayim — hare ze eno gole! ha ittemar ala, amar rav hoshaya: chayyshinan shemma haruach bilbelattu. i name, shemma ihu

a: Kerav mitato. may benayyhu?
Deshachteh beveta deshesha ufarkes. i name: deshachteh bevara vela parkes.
Rabbi yehuda omer: lo kol vechulei. ibbaya lehu: rabbi yehuda ben bava lekulla pelig, o lechumera pelig.

Ta shema: dehahu gavra detava becharme, veassekuhu abbe hadaya levatar telata yomin, veanseva rav dimi minnehardea lidvethu. vetu: hahu gavra ditva bediglat, veassekuhu aggishra deshabbistana, veanseva rava lidvethu appumma deshoshvine levatar chamsha yome.
I amrat bishlama lekulla pelig, inhu daavud kerabbi yehuda ben bava. ella i amrat lechumera pelig, inhu daavud keman? shane mayya, detzamti.
Vehaamrat mayya marzu makka! hane mille hecha deikka makka, aval hecha delekka makka — mitzmat tzamet. vehane mille dechi assekeh chazyeh beshateh. aval ishtahi, mitpach tafach.
Mishna nafal lemayim, ben sheyyesh lahen sof, ben sheen lahen sof — ishto asura. amar rabbi meir: maase beechad shennafal levor haggadol, veala leachar shelosha yamim.

Amar rabbi yose: maase besome sheyyarad litbol bimara, veyarad moshcho acharav, veshahu kede shettetze nafsham — vehissiu et neshotehem. veshuv maase beasya, beechad sheshshilsheluhu layyam, velo alta beyadam ella raglo, amru chachamim: min haarkubba ulemala — tinnase. min haarkubba ulematta — lo tinnase.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: nafal lammayim, ben sheyyesh lahem sof, ben sheen lahem sof — ishto asura, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: mayim sheyyesh lahem sof — ishto mutteret, vesheen lahem sof — ishto asura.
Hechi dame mayim sheyyesh lahem sof? amar abbaye: kol sheomed veroe mearba ruchotav.
Hahu gavra ditva beagma desamke, anseva rav shela lidvethu. amar leh rav lishmuel, ta neshammeteh. amar leh: nishlach leh beresha.

Shelachu leh: mayim sheen lahem sof, ishto asura o mutteret? shelach lehu: ishto asura. veagma desamke — mayim sheyyesh lahem sof, o mayim sheen lahem sof? shelach lehu: mayim sheen lahem sof hu. umar, may tama avad hachi?
Mita teena, ana sevari kevan dikvu vekayymi — kemayim sheyyesh lahem sof dame, vela hi: kevan deikka galle — emor galle ashpelu[].
Kare shemuel aleh derav: "lo yeunne latztzaddik kol aven". kare rav aleh dishmuel: "uteshua berov yoetz".

Tanya, amar rabbi: maase bishne bene adam mechammerin michmorin bayyarden, venichnas echad mehem limchilla shel dagim, veshaka chamma velo raa pitchah shel mechilla, veshaha chavero kede shettetze nafsho, uva vehodia betoch beto. lemachar, zarcha chamma vehikkir pitchah shel mechilla, uva umatza hesped gadol betoch beto. amar rabbi: kamma gedolim divre chachamim, sheamru: mayim sheyyesh lahem sof — ishto mutteret, sheen lahem sof — ishto asura.
I hachi, mayim sheyyesh lahem sof name, lechush limchilla shel dagim! bemayim sheyyesh lahem sof mechilla shel dagim la shechicha.

Amar rav ashe: ha daamaru rabbanan mayim sheen lahem sof ishto asura — hane mille beinish dealma, aval tzureba merabbanan — la. i dislek — kala it leh. vela hi: la shena inish dealma, vela shena tzureba merabbanan, diavad — in, lechattechilla — la.

Tanya, amar rabban gamliel: paam achat hayiti mehallech bisfina, veraiti sefina achat shennishbera. vehayiti mitztaer al talmid chacham shebbah, umannu — rabbi akiva. ucheshealiti bayyabbasha, ba veyashav vedan lefanay bahalacha. amarti lo: beni, mi heelcha? amar li: daf shel sefina nizdammen li, vechol gal vegal shebba alay — ninati lo roshi.
Mikkan amru chachamim: im yavou reshaim al adam — yenanea lo rosho. amarti beotah shaa: kamma gedolim divre chachamim, sheamru: mayim sheyyesh lahem sof — mutteret, mayim sheen lahem sof — asura.

Tanya, amar rabbi akiva: paam achat hayiti mehallech bisfina, veraiti sefina achat shemmittarefet bayyam, vehayiti mitztaer al talmid chacham shebbah, umannu — rabbi meir. keshealiti limdinat kappotkeya, ba veyashav vedan lefanay bahalacha. amarti lo: beni, mi heelcha? amar li: gal teradani lachavero, vachavero lachavero, ad shehekiani layyabbasha. amarti beotah shaa: kamma gedolim divre chachamim, sheamru: mayim sheyyesh lahem sof — ishto mutteret, mayim sheen lahem sof — ishto asura.

Tanu rabbanan: nafal legov arayot — en meidin alav. lachafura melea nechashim veakrabbim — meidin alav. rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: af lachafura melea nechashim veakrabbim en meidin alav, chayyshinan
b: Shemma chabbar hu. vetanna kamma, aggav itztza mazzeki leh.

Tanu rabbanan: nafal letoch kivshan haesh — meidin alav. leyora melea yayin vashemen — meidin alav. mishshum rabbi acha amru: shel shemen — meidin alav, mippene shehu mavir. shel yayin — en meidin alav, mippene shehu mechabbe. amru lo: techillato mechabbe vesofo mavir.

Amar rabbi meir: maase beechad shennafal labbor haggadol vechulei. tanya, amru lo lerabbi meir: en mazkirin maase nissim. may maase nissim? illema dela achal vela ishti — vehachtiv: "vetzumu alay veal tochlu veal tishtu".
Ella dela nayem. deamar rabbi yochanan: shevua shello ishan shelosha yamim — malkin oto, veyishan lealtar.
Verabbi meir may tama? amar rav kahana: kippin al gav kippin havo. verabbanan — deshesha havo. verabbi meir: i efshar dela mesarech venayem pureta.

Tanu rabbanan: maase bevitto shel nechuneya chofer shichin shennafla levor haggadol, uvau vehodiu lerabbi chanina ben dosa. shaa rishona, amar lahem: shalom. sheniyya, amar lahem: shalom. shelishit, amar lahem: alta.

Amar lah: bitti, mi heelech? amra lo: zachar shel rechelim nizdammen li, vezaken manhigo. amru lo: navi atta? amar lahem: "lo navi anochi velo ben navi anochi", ella: davar shehatztzaddik mitassek bo — yikkashel bo zaro?

Amar rabbi abba: af al pi chen met beno batztzama, shenneemar: "usevivav nisara meod", melammed shehakkadosh baruch hu medakdek im sevivav kechut hassaara. rabbi chanina amar, mehacha: "el naaratz besod kedoshim rabba venora al kol sevivav".

Mishna afillu shama min hannashim omrot "met ish peloni" — dayyo. rabbi yehuda omer: afillu shama min hattinokot omrim "hare anu holchin lispod velikbor et ish peloni". ben shehu mitkavven, uven sheeno mitkavven.
Rabbi yehuda ben bava omer: beyisrael, af al pi shehu mitkavven, uvegoy im haya mitkavven — en eduto edut.
Gemara vedilma la azli? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel, dekaamri: "harenu bain millispod umillikbor et ish peloni".
Vedilma kamtza bealma shechev leh veassiku leh al shemeh! dekaamri: ken vechen rabbanan havo hatam. ken vechen safdane havo hatam.

Uvegoy, im haya mitkavven vechulei. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo shanu ella shennitkavven lehattir, aval nitkavven lehaid — eduto edut. hechi yadinan? amar rav yosef: ba levet din veamar: "ish peloni met, hassiu et ishto" — zehu nitkavven lehattir. "met" setam — zehu nitkavven leedut.

Ittemar name, amar resh lakish: lo shanu ella shennitkavven lehattir, aval nitkavven lehaid — eduto edut. amar leh rabbi yochanan: lo kach haya maase beoshaya berabbi, shehittiram im shemonim vachamishsha zekenim. amar lahem: lo shanu ella shennitkavven lehattir, aval nitkavven lehaid — eduto edut. velo hodu lo chachamim.

Ella matnitin dekatane: uvegoy, im haya mitkavven — en eduto edut, hechi mashkachat la? bemesiach lefi tummo. ki hahu dahava kaamar veazel: "man ikka be chivvay, man ikka be chivvay, shechev chivvay", veanseva rav yosef lidvethu. hahu dahava kaamar veazel: "vavy leh lefarasha zeriza dahava befumebdita dishchev", veanseva rav yosef, veittema rava, lidvethu.

Hahu dahava kaamar veazel: "man ikka be chasa, teva chasa". amar rav nachman: haelokim! achalu kevore lechasa middibbureh derav nachman. azala devethu dechasa veinnasva, vela amaru lah vela midde. amar rav ashe: shema minna, ha daamur rabbanan mayim sheen lahem sof ishto asura, hane mille lechattechilla, aval i nasev — la mappekinan la minneh.
Ikka deamri, anseva rav nachman lidvethu, amar: chasa gavra rabba iteh, im ita dislek — kala it leh lemilleta. vela hi: la shena gavra rabba, la shena lav gavra rabba — diavad in, lechattechilla la.

Hahu goy dahava kaamar leh leyisrael: ketol aspasta ushedi lecheva[ta]i beshabbeta, vei la — katelna lach kediktelna lifloni bar yisrael, daamari leh: bashshel li kedera beshabbat, vela bashshel li, uketelteh. shemaa devethu, vaatay lekammeh deabbaye. (sheheta)

a: Telata rigle. amar la rav adda bar ahava: zil lekammeh derav yosef, decharif sakkine.

Azala kammeh. peshat meha matnitin: goy shehaya mocher perot bashshuk, veamar: "perot hallalu shel orla hen" "shel azeka hen", "shel neta revai hen" — lo amar kelum, lo nitkavvevn ella lehashebiach mikkacho.
Abba yudan ish tzayydan amar: maase beyisrael vegoy shehalchu badderech, uva goy veamar: "chaval al yehudi shehaya immi badderech shemmet badderech, ukevartiv", vehissiu ishto.

Veshuv maase bekolar shel bene adam, shehayu mehallechin leantochya, uva goy echad veamar: "chaval al kolar shel bene adam shemmetu, ukevartim", vehissiu et neshotehem. veshuv maase beshishshim bene adam shehayu mehallechin lecharkom better, uva goy veamar: "chaval al shishshim bene adam shehayu mehallechin bederech better shemmetu, ukevartim" vehissiu et neshotehem.

Mishna meidin leor hanner uleor hallevana, umassiin al pi bat kol. maase beechad sheamad al rosh hahar veamar: "ish peloni ben peloni mimmakom peloni met". halchu velo matzu sham adam, vehissiu et ishto.
Veshuv maase betzalmon, beechad sheamar: "ani ish peloni ben ish peloni, neshachani nachash vahare ani met". vehalchu velo hikkiruhu, vehalchu vehissiu et ishto.

Gemara amar rabba bar shemuel: tana, bet shammay omrim: en massiin al pi bat kol. uvet hillel omrim: massiin al pi bat kol. may ka mashma lan, matnitin hi! ha ka mashma lan dei mashkachat setama deen massiin — bet shammay hi.
Vehalchu velo matzu. vedilma shed hava? amar rav yehuda amar rav: sherau lo demut adam. inhu name damu! dachazo leh bavua.
Veinhu name it lehu bavua! dachazo leh bavua devavua. vedilma ledidhu it lehu bavua devavua. amar rabbi chanina, amar li yonatan sheda: bavua — it lehu, bavua devavua — let lehu.
Vedilma tzara havay? tana deve rabbi yishmael: bishat hassakkana kotvin venotnin, af al pi sheen makkirin.

Mishna amar rabbi akiva: kesheyyaradti linhardea leabber hashshana, metzaani nechemya ish bet deli, amar li: shamati sheen massiin et haishsha beeretz yisrael al pi ed echad ella yehuda ben bava. venummeti lo: ken haddevarim. amar li, emor lahem mishshemi: attem yodim shehammedina meshubbeshet bigyaysot, mekubbelani merabban gamliel hazzaken shemmassiin et haishsha al pi ed echad.
Ucheshebbati vehirtzeti haddevarim lifne rabban gamliel, samach lidvaray, veamar: matzanu chaver lerabbi yehuda ben bava.

Mittoch haddavar, nizkar rabban gamliel shennehergu harugim betel arza, vehissi rabban gamliel neshotehen al pi ed echad. vehuchezku lihyot massiin ed mippi ed, mippi eved, mippi ishsha, mippi shifcha. rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua omrim: en massiin et haishsha al pi ed echad. rabbi akiva omer: lo al pi ishsha, velo al pi eved, velo al pi shifcha, velo al pi kerovim.

Gemara vesavar rabbi akiva al pi ishsha la? vehatanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi akiva: ishsha neemenet lehavi gittah mikkal vachomer; uma nashim sheamru chachamim en neemanot lomar "met balah" — neemanot lehavi gittehen, zo shenneemenet lomar "met balah" — eno din shenneemenet lehavi gittah.
Nashim sheamru chachamim hu dela mehemni, ishsha bealma — mehemna. la kashya: kan kodem shehecheziku, kan leachar shehecheziku.

Mishna amru lo: maase bivne levi shehalchu letzoar ir hattemarim, vechala echad mehem, veheviuhu befunedak. uvachazaratam amru lappunedakit: "ayye chaverenu?" nummet lahem: "met, ukevartiv", vehissiu et ishto. velo tehe kohenet kefunedakit?
Amar lehu: lichshettehe kefunedakit — neemenet. happunedakit hotzia lahem maklo vetarmilo vesefer tora shehaya beyado.
b: Gemara may geriuta defunedakit? amar rav kahana: punedakit — goya hayta, umesicha lefi tumma hayta: "ze maklo, veze tarmilo, veze kever shekkevartiv bo". vechen tane abba bereh derav minyome bar chiyyay: punedakit goya hayta, umesicha lefi tumma hayta: "ze maklo, veze tarmilo, veze kever shekkevartiv bo".
Veha "ayye chaverenu" kaamri lah? kevan dachazetinhu, bachya. amru lah: "ayye chaverenu?" amra lahem: "met ukevartiv".
