Tanu rabbanan: maase beadam echad shebba lehaid al haishsha lifne rabbi tarfon. amar lo: "beni, heach atta yodea beedut ishsha zo?" amar: "ani vahu hayinu holchim badderech, veradaf acharenu gayis, venitla beyichur shel zayit ufeshacho, vehechzir et haggayis laachorav".

"Amarti lo: 'arye! yishar kochacha. amar li: 'minnayin atta yodea shearye shemi? kach korin oti beiri: yochanan berabbi yehonatan, arye demikkefar shichya. leyamim chala umet." vehissi rabbi tarfon et ishto.

Verabbi tarfon la bae derisha vachakira? vehatanya: maase beadam echad shebba lifne rabbi tarfon lehaid edut ishsha. amar lo: "beni, heach atta yodea edut zo?" amar lo: "ani vahu hayinu holchin badderech, veradaf acharenu gayis, venitla beyichur teena ufeshacho. vehechzir et haggayis laachorav. amarti lo: 'yishar kochacha arye!' amar li: 'yafe kivvavnta lishmi, shekkach korin oti beiri: yochanan ben yonatan arye demikkefar shichya. leyamim chala umet".

Amar lo: "lo kach amrat li yochanan ben yonatan demikkefar shichya arye?" amar leh: "lo, ella kach amarti lach: yochanan ben yonatan arye demikkefar shichya". vedikdek alav shenayim ushelosha peamim, vechivven et devarav, vehissi rabbi tarfon et ishto.
Tannae hi. detanya: en bodkin ede nashim bidrisha vachakira, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi tarfon omer: bodkin.
Vekamippalgi bidrabbi chanina. deamar rabbi chanina: devar tora, echad dine mamonot veechad dine nefashot bidrisha vachakira. shenneemar: "mishpat echad yihye lachem".
Uma taam amru dine mamonot en tzerichin derisha vachakira — shello tinol delet bifne lovin.
Uvemay kamippalgi — mar savar: kevan deikka ketubba lemishkal — kedine mamonot dame, umar savar: kevan deka sharenan eshet ish lealma — kedine nefashot dame.
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: talmide chachamim marbim shalom baolam, shenneemar: "vechol banayich limmude Adonai verav shelom banayich".
Hadaran alach haishsha batra uselika la massechet yevamot

a: Betula nisset layyom harvii vealmana layyom hachamishi. sheppaamayim beshabbat batte dinin yoshvin baayayrot: bayyom hashsheni uvayyom hachamishi, sheim haya lo taanat betulim, haya mashkim levet din.
Gemara amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mippene ma amru betula nisset layyom harvii? lefi sheshshaninu: higgia zeman velo nisseu — ochlot mishshello, veochlot bitruma.
Yachol higgia zeman beechad beshabbat yehe maale lah mezonot? lechach shaninu: betula nisset layyom harvii.
Amar rav yosef: mareh deavraham! tale tanya bidla tanya?! he tanya vehe la tanya? ha tanya veha tanya! ella: tale tanya dimfaresh tama bidtanya dela mefaresh tama.

Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mippene ma amru betula nisset layyom harvii? sheim haya lo taanat betulim — haya mashkim levet din. vetinnase beechad beshabbat, sheim haya lo taanat betulim haya mashkim levet din? shakdu chachamim al takkanat benot yisrael, sheyyehe toreach bisuda shelosha yamim, echad beshabbat vesheni bashshabbat ushelishi bashshabbat, uvarvii konsah.

Veachshav sheshshaninu "shakdu", otah sheshshaninu "higgia zeman velo nisseu, ochlot mishshello veochlot bitruma", higgia zeman beechad beshabbat, mittoch sheeno yachol lichnos — eno maale lah mezonot.
Lefichach: chala hu o shechalta hi o sheppersa nidda — eno maale lah mezonot.
Veikka devae la mibbaya: chala hu, mahu? hatam tama may — mishshum daanis, vehacha name ha anis. o dilma: hatam anis betakkanta detakkinu le rabbanan, hacha la.
Veim timtze lomar chala hu maale lah mezonot: chalta hi, mahu? matze amar la: ana ha kaemna, o dilma matzya amra leh: "nistachafa sadehu".
Veim timtze lomar amra leh "nistachafa sadehu" — persa nidda, mahu?
Bishat vivstah, la tibbee lach
b: Dela matzya amra leh "nistachafa sadehu". ki tibbee lach shello bishat vivstah, may? kevan dela bishat vivstah havya, matzya amra leh "nistachafa sadehu", o dilma kevan deikka neshe deka meshanneyay vivstayyhu — kishat vivstah dame.
Pashet rav achay: higgia zeman velo nisseu — ochlot mishshello veochlot bitruma. "lo nasu" la katane, ella "lo nisseu".
Hechi dame: i deka meakkevan inhi — ammay ochlot mishshello veochlot bitruma? ella lav, deittenis ki hay gavvna, vekatane: ochlot mishshello veochlot bitruma.
Amar rav ashe: leolam ema lach kol unesa, la achla, udeka meakkevi inhu. uvedin hu deibbei leh lemitne "lo nasu", veayyeyde ditna resha bedidhi, tena name sefa bedidhi.
Amar rava: uleinyan gittin eno ken. alma kasavar rava en ones begittin.
Mena leh lerava ha? illema meha ditnan: "hare ze gittech im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh", umet betoch shenem asar chodesh — eno get. met hu deeno get, ha chala — hare ze get.
Vedilma leolam ema lach chala name eno get, vehi gufa ka mashma lan, deen get leachar mita.
En get leachar mita — ha tena leh resha: "hare ze gittech im matti", "hare ze gittech mecholi ze", "hare ze gittech leachar mita" — lo amar kelum.

Dilma leappoke midderabbotenu. detanya: verabbotenu hittiruha lehinnase, veamrinan: man rabbotenu? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: be dina dishro mishcha. savri la kerabbi yose, deamar: zemanno shel shetar mochiach alav.
Veella missefa: "meachshav im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh", umet betoch shenem asar chodesh — hare ze get. met, vehu haddin lechala.
Dilma met davka, dela nicha leh detippol kamme yavam!
Ella meha: dehahu daamar lehu "i la atena mikkan vead telatin yomin leheve gitta", ata besof telatin yomin ufaskeh mabbara. amar lehu: chazo daatay, chazo daatay. amar shemuel: lav shemeh matya.
Vedilma unesa dishchiach shane. dechevan deibbei leh leatnoye vela atni — ihu deafsed annafsheh.
Ella rava sevara denafsheh kaamar: mishshum tzenuot umishshum perutzot. mishshum tzenuot — dei amrat la leheve get,

a: Zimnin dela anis vesavra daanis, umiaggena veyatva. umishshum perutzot — dei amrat la leheve gitta, zimnin daanis veamra la anis, veazla uminnasva, venimtza get batel uvaneha mamzerim.
Umi ikka midde demiddeorayyta la leheve get, umishshum tzenuot umishshum perutzot sharinan eshet ish lealma?!
In, kol dimkaddesh addata derabbanan mekaddesh, veafkeinhu rabbanan lekiddushe minneh.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: tinach kaddesh bechaspa. kaddesh bevia may ikka lememar? shavveyu rabbanan livilato beilat zenut.
Ikka deamri: amar rava, vechen leinyan gittin. alma kasavar rava yesh ones begittin.
Metivi: "hare ze gittech im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh", umet betoch shenem asar chodesh — eno get. met hu deeno get, ha chala — hare ze get!
Leolam ema lach chala name eno get, vehi gufa ka mashma lan: deen get leachar mita.
En get leachar mita ha tena leh resha! dilma leappoke midderabbotenu.
Ta shema: "meachshav im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh", umet betoch shenem asar chodesh — hare ze get. may lav, hu haddin lechala! la, met davka, dela nicha leh detippol kamme yavam.
Ta shema mehahu daamar lehu "i la atena mikkan vead sheloshim yom leheve gitta", ata besof telatin yomin ufaskeh mabbara, vaamar lehu: "chazo daatay! chazo daatay!" vaamar shemuel: la shemeh matya!
Unesa dishchiach — shane, dechevan deibbei leh leatnoye vela atni, ihu hu deafsed annafsheh.

Amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak: lo shanu ella mittakkanat ezra veelach, sheen batte dinin kevuin ella besheni uvachamishi. aval kodem takkanat ezra, shebbatte dinin kevuin bechol yom — ishsha nisset bechol yom.
Kodem takkanat ezra? may dahava hava! hachi kaamar: i ikka batte dinin dikvuin haiddana kekodem takkanat ezra — ishsha nisset bechol yom.
Ha bainan shakdu! ditriach leh.
b: May "shakdu"? detanya: mippene ma amru betula nisset layyom harvii? sheim haya lo taanat betulim, haya mashkim levet din. vetinnase beechad beshabbat, veim haya lo taanat betulim haya mashkim levet din! shakdu chachamim al takkanat benot yisrael, sheyyehe adam toreach basseuda shelosha yamim: echad bashshabbat vesheni beshabbat ushelishi bashshabbat, uvarvii konsah.

Umissakkana veelach nahagu haam lichnos bashshelishi, velo michu beyadam chachamim. uvashsheni lo yichnos. veim mechamat haones — muttar. umafrishin et hechatan min hakkalla lele shabbat techilla, mippene shehu ose chabbura.
May sakkana? illema deamri betula hannisset layyom harvii tehareg — nahagu?! ligmare nikereh!
Amar rabba, deamri: betula hannisset beyom harvii tibbael lahegmon techilla. hay sakkana? ones hu! mishshum deikka tzenuot demasran nafshayyhu liktala, veatyayn lide sakkana.
Velidrosh lehu deones shere? ikka perutzot, veikka name kohanot.
Velikereh! shemada avida devatla, vetakkanta derabbanan mikkamme shemada la akrinan. i hachi, bashshelishi name ate uvael! missefeka la akar nafsheh.
Uvashsheni lo yichnos, veim mechamat haones — muttar. may ones? illema ha daamaran, hatam kare leh "sakkana", vehacha ka kare leh "ones"?! vetu: hatam nahagu, hacha muttar?
Amar rava, deamri: sar tzava ba lair. hechi dame? i deate vechalef — liakkav! la tzericha, deate vekava. bashshelishi miha lichnos? isparvo dideh bishlishi kaatu.

Veibbaet ema: may "mechamat haones" — kidtanya: hare shehaya pitto afuy, vetivcho tavuach, veyeno mazug, umet aviv shel chatan o immah shel kalla — machnisin et hammet lacheder, veet hechatan veet hakkalla lachuppa,

a: Uvoel beilat mitzva uforesh, venoheg shivat yeme hammishte, veachar kach noheg shivat yeme avelut. vechol otan hayyamim, hu yashen ben haanashim vehi yeshena ben hannashim. veen monin tachshitin min hakkalla kol sheloshim yom.
Vedavka, aviv shel chatan o immah shel kalla, delekka inish detarach lehu. aval ippecha — la.
Amar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella shennatan mayim al gabbe basar, aval lo natan mayim al gabbe basar — mizdabban.

Amar rava: uvichrach, af al pi shennatan mayim al gabbe basar — mizdabban. amar rav pappa: uvichfar, af al pi shello natan mayim al gabbe basar — la mizdabban. veella derav chisda hechi mashkachat la? amar rav ashe: kegon mata machseya, demappeka mikkerach, umappeka mikkefar.

Tanya kevoteh derav chisda: hare shehaya pitto afuya vetivcho tavuach veyeno mazug, venatan mayim al gabbe basar, umet aviv shel chatan o immah shel kalla — machnisin et hammet lacheder, veet hechatan veet hakkalla lachuppa, uvoel beilat mitzva uforesh, venoheg shivat yeme hammishte, veachar kach noheg shivat yeme avelut. vechol otan hayyamim, hu yashen ben haanashim veishto yeshena ben hannashim.

Vechen mi sheppersa ishto nidda — hu yashen ben haanashim vehi yeshena ben hannashim. veen monin tachshitin min hakkalla kol sheloshim yom. ben kach uven kach lo yivol, lo beerev shabbat velo bemotzae shabbat.
Amar mar: hu yashen ben haanashim vehi yeshena ben hannashim, mesayyay leh lerabbi yochanan. deamar rabbi yochanan: af al pi sheamru en avelut bammoed, aval devarim shel tzina — noheg.
Daresh rav yosef bereh derava mishshemeh derava: lo shanu ella shello baal, aval baal — ishto yeshena immo.
Veha hacha, divvaal askinan, vekatane: hu yashen ben haanashim vehi yeshena ben hannashim! ki kaamar, appersa ishto nidda.
Ha "vechen" katane!
b: Hachi kaamar: vechen mi sheppersa ishto nidda velo baal — hu yashen ben haanashim, veishto yeshena ben hannashim.
Lememra daavelut kayla leh minnidda?

Vehaamar rabbi yitzchak bar chanina amar rav huna: kol melachot sheishsha osa levalah — nidda osa levalah, chutz mimmezigat hakkos vehatztzaat hammitta, veharechatzat panav yadav veraglav. veillu gabbe avelut tanya: af al pi sheamru en adam rashshay lachof et ishto lihyot kochelet velihyot pokeset, beemet amru: mozeget lo hakkos, umatztzaat lo hammitta, umarchetzet lo panav yadav veraglav.
La kashya: kan — baavelut dideh, kan — baavelut dida.
Veha aviv shel chatan o immah shel kalla katane! ki katane, ashsheara.

Umi shane ben avelut dideh laavelut dida? vehatanya: mi shemmet chamiv o chamoto — eno yachol lachof et ishto lihyot kochelet velihyot pokeset, ella kofe mittato, venoheg immah avelut. vechen hi shemmet chamiha o chamotah — enah rashshaa lihyot kochelet velihyot pokeset, ella kofa mittatah venoheget immo avelut.

Teni baavelut dideh: hu yashen ben haanashim veishto yeshena ben hannashim. ha "vechen" katane! ki katane, akkichul veappirkus. veha "immo" katane, may lav immo bammitta! lo, immo babbayit. uchedaamar leh rav lechiyyay bereh: beappa nehog aviluta, dela beappa la tinhog aviluta.
Rav ashe amar: mi kamdammet aviluta dehacha laaviluta dealma? aviluta dealma chamir, vela ate lezalzole beh. avelut dehacha, kevan deakkilu rabbanan, ate lezalzole beh.
May kulla? illema dekatane boel beilat mitzva uforesh — hatam mishshum delo chal alav aviluta, i lerabbi eliezer ad sheyyetze mippetach habbayit, i lerabbi yehoshua ad sheyyissatem haggolel.
Ella dekatane: noheg shivat yeme hammishte, veachar kach noheg shivat yeme avelut.
Amar mar: ben kach uven kach lo yivol, lo baerev shabbat velo bemotzae shabbat. bishlama beerev shabbat — mishshum chabbura. ella bemotzae shabbat, ammay la?
Amar rabbi zera:

a: Mishshum cheshbonot.

Amar leh abbaye: vecheshbonot shel mitzva mi asiri? veha rav chisda verav hamenuna deamri tarvayyhu: cheshbonot shel mitzva muttar lechashshevan beshabbat! veamar rabbi elazar: poskin tzedaka laaniyyim beshabbat! veamar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: holchin levatte chenesiyyot ulevatte midrashot lefakkeach al iske rabbim beshabbat. veamar rabbi yaakov bar idde amar rabbi yochanan: mefakkechin pikkuach nefesh beshabbat.

Veamar rav shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: holchin leteratyayot ulekirkeyayot lefakkeach al iske rabbim beshabbat. vetana deve menashsheya: meshaddechin al hattinoket leares beshabbat, veal hattinok lelammedo sefer ulelammedo ummanut.

Ella, amar rabbi zera: gezera shemma yishchot ben of. amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, yom hakkippurim shechal lihyot besheni beshabbat yiddache, gezera shemma yishchot ben of! hatam dilnafsheh — la terid, hacha delaacherim — terid. i name: hatam it leh ravvcha, hacha let leh ravvcha.
Hasheta deatet lehachi, erev shabbat name — gezera shemma yishchot ben of.
Ibbaya lehu: betula nisset barvii venivelet barvii, vela chayyshinan leikkarore data, o dilma: betula nisset barvii venivelet bachamishi, dechayyshinan leikkarore data.

Ta shema, detane bar kappara: betula nisset barvii venivelet bachamishi, hoil veneemra bo beracha laddagim. almana nisset bachamishi venivelet bashshishshi — hoil veneemra bo beracha laadam. tama mishshum beracha, aval mishshum ikkarore data — la chayyshinan.
I hachi, almana name tibbael bachamishi, hoil veneemra bo beracha laddagim! beracha deadam adifa leh.

Vei name: mishshum shakdu. detanya: mippene ma amru almana nisset bachamishi venivelet bashshishshi? sheim atta omer tibbael bachamishi, lemachar mashkim leummanuto veholech lo. shakdu chachamim al takkanat benot yisrael, sheyyehe sameach immah shelosha yamim: chamishi beshabbat, veerev shabbat, veshabbat.
May ikka ben "beracha" leshakdu"? ikka benayyhu adam batel. i name: yom tov shechal lihyot beerev shabbat.

Darash bar kappara: gedolim maase tzaddikim yoter mimmaase shamayim vaaretz, deillu bemaase shamayim vaaretz ketiv: "af yadi yasda eretz vimini tippecha shamayim", veillu bemaase yedehem shel tzaddikim ketiv: "machon leshivtecha paalta Adonai mikkedash adonay konnu yadecha".

Heshiv bavli echad, verabbi chiyyay shemo: "veyabbeshet yadav yatzaru"! "yado" ketiv. vehachtiv "yatzaru"! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: yatzru etzbeotav, kedichtiv: "ki ere shamecha maase etzbeotecha yareach vechochavim asher konanta".
Metivi: "hashshamayim mesapperim kevod el umaase yadav maggid harakia"! hachi kaamar: maase yedehem shel tzaddikim mi maggid — harakia, umay nihu — matar.
Darash bar kappara, may dichtiv: "veyated tihye lecha al azenecha". al tikre "azenecha", ella "al oznecha" — sheim yishma adam davar sheeno hagun,
b: Yanniach etzbao beoznav. vehayeynu deamar rabbi elazar: mippene ma etzbeotav shel adam domot litedot? may tama? illema mishshum dimchallekan, kol chada vachada lemilletay avida. deamar mar: zo zeret. zo kemitza. zo amma. zo etzba. ze gudal.

Ella: ma taam meshuppot kitedot — sheim yishma adam davar sheeno hagun, yanniach etzbeotav beoznav. tana deve rabbi yishmael: mippene ma ozen kullah kasha vehaalya rakka? sheim yishma adam davar sheeno hagun, yachof alya letochah. tanu rabbanan: al yashmia adam leoznav devarim betelim, mippene shehen nichvot techilla leevarim.
Ibbaya lehu: mahu livol battechilla beshabbat. dam mifkad pekid, o chabbore michabbar?
Veim timtze lomar dam mifkad pekid: laddam hu tzarich, ushere. o dilma lappetach hu tzarich, vaasir.
Veim timtze lomar laddam hu tzarich, ufetach mimmela kaate — halacha kerabbi shimon deamar davar sheen mitkavven muttar, o halacha kerabbi yehuda deamar davar sheen mitkavven asur?
Veim timtze lomar halacha kerabbi yehuda — mekalkel hu etzel happetach, o metakken hu etzel happetach?
Ikka deamri: veim timtze lomar dam chabbore michabbar — laddam hu tzarich, veasur, o dilma lahanaat atzmo hu tzarich, veshare?
Veim timtze lomar lahanaat atzmo hu tzarich, vedam mimmela kaate — halacha kerabbi yehuda o halacha kerabbi shimon?
Veim timtze lomar halacha kerabbi yehuda — mekalkel bechabbura o metakken bechabbura hu?
Veim timtze lomar mekalkel bechabbura hu — bimkalkel halacha kerabbi yehuda,

a: O halacha kerabbi shimon.
(Ittemar:) beve rav amri: rav share ushemuel asar. binhardea amri: rav asar ushemuel share. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, vesimanaych: ellu mekillin leatzman veellu mekillin leatzman.
Verav share? vehaamar rav shimi bar chizkiyya mishshemeh derav: hay mesocharya denazyayta — asur lehaddoka beyoma tava!
Behahu afillu rabbi shimon mode, deabbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut".

Veha amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: halacha kerabbi yehuda. verav chanan bar amme amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi shimon. verav chiyyay bar avin matne la bela gavre, rav amar: halacha kerabbi yehuda, ushemuel amar: halacha kerabbi shimon.
Leolam rav kerabbi yehuda sevira leh, lehach lishshana deamar dam mifkad pekid — mekalkel hu etzel happetach. lehach lishshana deamar dam chabbore michabbar — mekalkel bechabbura hu.
Metiv rav chisda: tinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot venisset, bet shammay omrim: notnin lah arbaa lelot, uvet hillel omrim: ad shettichye hammakka.
Higgia zemannah lirot venisset, bet shammay omrim: notnin lah layla harishon. uvet hillel omrim: ad motzae shabbat, arbaa lelot.
b: May lav: dei lo baal, matze bael afillu beshabbat. amar rava: la, levar mishshabbat. amar leh abbaye: veha "ad motzae shabbat arbaa lelot" katane? ella, amar rava: keshebbaal.
I keshebbaal, may ka mashma lan? ka mashma lan dishre lemival beshabbat, kedishmuel. deamar shemuel: pirtza dechuka muttar likkanes bah beshabbat, veaf al pi shemmashshir tzerorot.
Metiv rav yosef: chatan patur mikkeriyyat shema layla harishon ad motzae shabbat im lo asa maase. may lav, ditrid devae lemival! amar leh abbaye: la, ditrid dela beel.

Amar leh rava: umishshum tirda patur? ella meatta, tava sefinato bayyam, hachi name defatur?! vechi tema hachi name — vehaamar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav: avel chayyayv bechol hammitzvot haamurot betorah chutz min hattefillin, shenneemar bahen "peer"!
Ella amar rava: tannae hi. detana chada: im lo asa maase barishon — patur af bashsheni, bashsheni — patur af bashshelishi.
Vetanya iddach: rishon vesheni — patur, shelishi — chayyayv.
Veabbaye? hatam name betirda peligi.
Vehane tannae ki hane tannae. detanya: hakkones et habbetula — lo yivol battechilla beshabbat, vachachamim mattirin.
Man chachamim? amar rabba: rabbi shimon hi, deamar: davar sheen mitkavven muttar.
Amar leh abbaye: veha mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut"! amar leh: lo kehallalu bavliyyim sheen bekiin behattayay, ella yesh bekiin behattayay.
Im ken, tored lamma? lesheeno baki. yomru: baki — muttar, sheeno baki — asur! rov bekiin hen.
Amar leh rava bar rav chanan leabbaye: ella meatta shoshvinin, lamma? mappa lamma? amar leh: hatam shemma yire viabbed.
Metiv rabbi amme: hammefis muresa beshabbat, im laasot lah pe — chayyayv. veim lehotzi mimmenna lecha —
